items.title: Chinese Firms Exit Kenya Rare Earths Race as U.S. Companies Move In
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: By Ammu Kannampilly Engineering giant Fluor Corp is among a group of mostly U.S. investors vying to develop Kenya’s Mrima Hill critical minerals deposit, after two Chinese companies pulled out of the process, Kenya’s mining minister told Reuters on Friday. A final …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
By Ammu Kannampilly

Engineering giant Fluor Corp is among a group of mostly U.S. investors vying to develop Kenya’s Mrima Hill critical minerals deposit, after two Chinese companies pulled out of the process, Kenya’s mining minister told Reuters on Friday.

A final decision would be announced within three weeks, he said.

Reuters is first to report Fluor Corp’s bid, the timing of the final announcement and the withdrawal of the Chinese companies — Hunan Research Institute for Nonferrous Metals and Jinan Yuxiao Group Co. Ltd.

U.S. President Donald Trump has made securing access to critical minerals a priority of his administration, inking deals with a number of African nations as Washington looks to cut dependence on top producer China, which dominates the global supply chain and has tightened export controls in recent years.

China is also a dominant player in Africa’s mining industry.

Kenya’s mining minister Hassan Ali Joho said that five contenders had submitted tenders on October 21 for the Mrima Hill deposit in southern Kenya, around 65 kilometers from the port city of Mombasa. They include two U.S. consortia, one U..S-affiliated consortium, an Australian consortium and a Kenyan-British joint venture.

“American entities have strongly showcased or demonstrated interest by participating in our transparent process in identifying the developer of Mrima Hill,” Joho said in an interview.

“Within the next two to three weeks we should be able to award Mrima Hills to the successful bidder.”

Joho said preliminary indicators suggest the coastal deposit contains tens of billions of dollars’ worth of rare earth minerals and niobium, a metal used in aerospace manufacturing, with deposits primarily mined in Brazil and Canada.

Chinese Firms Said to Have Submitted Other Bids

The two U.S. consortia are Meridian Mineral Holdings, which includes Fluor Corp and Tetra Tech, and Frontier Minerals LLC, which includes rare earths startup ReElement Technologies. Joho also said a U.S.-affiliated consortium called Mrima Earth was on the shortlist, led by Critical Metals Corp, which is pursuing the Tanbreez rare earth project in Greenland.

A Kenyan-British joint venture called Gem of Dreams also submitted a tender, as has Australia’s RareX in a tie-up with Iluka Resources. Rare X announced in July that it had been shortlisted to compete for the project.

Fluor Corp previously built the Eneabba rare earths refinery in Western Australia for Iluka Resources, but the two are now aggressively competing for the Mrima Hill project.

A representative for the Australian joint venture told Reuters that Fluor Corp was not licensed to use any intellectual property related to the Eneabba plant.

“Should Fluor make use of or appear to be making use of Iluka’s IP in designing and constructing a processing plant for Mrima Hill, there would be a high chance of legal action to protect IP rights,” the representative said.

Fluor Corp and Meridian did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment on the Australian consortium’s comment.

‘No Pressure’ From Washington or Beijing

The other three consortia and the Chinese companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the Mrima Hill project.

Joho said he did not know why the Chinese firms withdrew, adding that the Kenyan government did not directly engage with the bidders.

“We haven’t had any conversation with anybody, and we haven’t offered any alternative to anybody… We want a transparent process,” he said.

Two sources with direct knowledge of the matter told Reuters that the Chinese firms had bid for other state mining projects in Kenya on the same day that the Mrima Hill tender was due last week. It was not immediately clear which projects received bids, but both sources said four other tenders for coltan, manganese, copper and chromite projects were due that day.

Joho told Reuters that one of the Chinese companies did file a bid for another project the same day, but declined to elaborate, saying it would compromise the process.

He said Kenya had faced “no pressure” from either Beijing or Washington on the issue.

“I don’t think it is in the place of anybody to tell us how and with whom to work. Our decisions are purely informed by the interests of this country.”

Shift to Domestic Processing

African nations have pushed in recent years to process more of the minerals they produce domestically, marking a shift toward keeping more value on the continent.

Kenya’s President William Ruto told Reuters in June that his government was close to signing a critical minerals deal with the United States, under which Nairobi would process its own resources domestically.

Officials in the Trump administration have also said the U.S. intends to help Kenya develop a critical minerals processing industry.

A U.S. State Department spokesperson told Reuters that U.S. companies had proven track records and a commitment to local processing.

“The U.S. Government will take every opportunity to help American businesses invest in emerging sectors and developing economies, including the mining sector,” the spokesperson said.

Ruto has previously said that Kenya would not choose between Washington and Beijing, but instead pursue multiple partnerships aligned with its own economic priorities.

In addition to rare earths and niobium, Kenya is also believed to have large untapped deposits of lithium, graphite, copper and nickel.

items.title: Trump clears $2.1 bn Patriot missile deal for Ukraine after Zelenskyy tensions: Is his Ukraine policy changing?
items.author: Swati Gandhi
items.summary: The US has approved a $2.1 billion sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine after weeks of tensions between Trump and Zelenskyy. Allies will help finance the purchase, but delivery delays remain a concern as Kyiv seeks protection from Russian attacks. What does this mean for US policy on Ukraine?
items.body: After weeks of tension between US President Donald Trump and his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelenskyy, Washington on Friday (local time) approved the sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles to Kyiv, the State Department announced.According to Reuters, the sale of 500 Patriot missiles has been approved at an estimated cost of $2.1 billion, in what is being considered one of the most significant steps to supply defensive weapons to war-torn Ukraine since the start of the second Trump administration. US approves Patriot missile sale for Ukraine: What we knowThe development comes at a time when Ukraine has long said it urgently requires more missile interceptors to defend against increasingly large Russian missile attacks. The Patriot system is Kyiv's most effective defence against high-speed ballistic missiles.Delayed missile deliveries have added to a growing list of tensions for Ukraine, especially after Trump announced a diesel deal with Russia and waived sanctions related to Moscow under the Graham Act. The US President also slammed Zelenskyy for the country's unwillingness to stop attacks on Russia's energy infrastructure.Earlier this week, the Ukrainian President said that Kyiv had been waiting for over a month for Washington to sign off on critical missile supplies as Russia intensified its attacks on energy and civilian infrastructure across the country.According to the report, despite its urgent need, Ukraine is likely to face a lengthy wait for the interceptors. Arms deals often take years to complete, and two people briefed on the US decision said the missiles have yet to be built, with deliveries not expected until the early 2030s.Who's paying for the 500 Patriot missiles?In a statement, the State Department announced that Kyiv will pay for these 500 Patriot missiles with contributions from Canada, Germany, and Norway channelled through a programme called US JUMPSTART, along with national funds financed by the European Union's Ukraine Support Loan.The department said, "This proposed sale will support the foreign policy and national security objectives of the United States by improving the security of a partner country that is a force for political and economic stability in Europe."It further noted, "Ukraine will pay for this purchase with donations from Canada, Germany, and Norway via the JUMPSTART program and national funds, financed by the European Union's Ukraine Support Loan."According to a Pentagon website, the US JUMPSTART programme allows allies to make donations to buy weapons, services, and training for Kyiv to support its self-defence following Moscow's invasion.Previously, the JUMPSTART programme was used in August to purchase 3,350 air-launched cruise missiles worth $825 million made by Zone 5 Technologies and CoAspire.What's changing in Trump's Ukraine policy?The Patriot sale suggests that Washington remains willing to supply defensive weapons to Ukraine despite Trump’s recent criticism of Zelenskyy. However, the purchase is being financed through allied contributions and European Union-backed funds. Alongside Trump’s diesel deal with Russia and sanctions waivers, the approval points to continued military support for Kyiv without establishing a broader change in Washington’s approach to the war.(with agency inputs)

FAST

BEIJING: China's factory activity unexpectedly dropped in October, its third contraction in four months, a government survey showed on Saturday (Oct 31), hurt by soft demand for exports as well as goods at home.
The official manufacturing purchasing managers' index (PMI) fell to 49.3 from 50.1 in September, according to data from the National Bureau of Statistics. That missed a forecast for 50.0 from a Reuters poll.
Factory activity weakened as overseas Christmas-related orders, which were front-loaded in September, cooled in October. It was also hurt when consumer spending, which climbed during China's long National Day holiday in the first week of October, fizzled out after, in a return to its long-stagnant state.
"Insufficient demand is increasing downward pressure on the economy," said Zhang Liqun, an analyst with the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing, adding that policymakers should take the problem seriously and step up measures as soon as possible.

Sub-indexes for new orders overall and for new export orders both stayed in contraction territory in October. Production and purchasing activity also slipped into contraction from expansion.
The non-manufacturing PMI, which covers services and construction, also dropped to 49.7 from 50.2 in September.
The readings are compiled based on purchasing managers' reports about whether conditions improved, worsened or were unchanged in areas such as new orders, output and employment compared with the previous month. A reading above 50 signals expansion, while one below 50 indicates contraction.
Some sectors within manufacturing were doing well.
Production and new orders sub-indexes for railway, shipbuilding, aerospace equipment, and computer, communications and electronics manufacturing were all at or above 53.0, the survey showed.
AI-related firms in particular have reported strong earnings growth. Zhongji Innolight, a maker of high-speed optical modules that connect servers and switches in AI data centres, posted a near tripling in third-quarter net profit.
But the lacklustre domestic market and rising costs have weighed on many old-school manufacturers and property-linked firms. Custom furniture maker Oppein Home, for example, saw net profit plunge 80 per cent during the quarter.
China's economy is, however, expected to meet the country's 4.5-5.0 per cent annual growth target without additional stimulus measures after third-quarter growth rebounded to 4.5 per cent from 4.3 per cent in April-June.

Source: Reuters/kl

items.title: Binance crypto exchange's $6.3 bn heist rattles crypto, draws scrutiny
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The US agencies are coordinating with private-sector partners to assess the breach and recover stolen funds, while Binance pledged to cover all losses ...
items.body: By Myles Miller, Emily Nicolle and Scott Patterson US law enforcement joined the hunt for hackers who drained more than $6 billion from the Binance crypto exchange in the biggest cyber theft ever recorded. The Federal Bureau of Investigation is aware of the incident and is coordinating with its partners “to understand the scope of the activity, evaluate potential impacts, and coordinate appropriate investigative steps,” the agency said in a statement to Bloomberg News on Friday. Secret Service investigators are also “working around the clock” with the private sector to recover stolen funds, a spokesperson said. The Justice Department is aware of reports about the attack but does not comment on investigations, a spokesperson said.  While the full details of the Binance breach have yet to emerge, the incident comes amid growing concern about the risks posed by hackers in the age of artificial intelligence. Other recent cyberattacks have hit prediction market Polymarket, South Korean financial firms Mirae Asset Global Investments Co. and Daishin Securities, as well as Japanese currency trading platform GMO Internet Group Inc. The world’s largest crypto trading platform suspended withdrawals and pledged to cover all losses. The exchange is able to do so as a result of its ongoing investment of revenue into cryptocurrencies, Binance co-Chief Executive Officer Richard Teng said in a video posted on social media on Friday. Yi He, who is co-CEO, said Binance’s revenue for this year would completely cover the amount lost. Withdrawals were expected to resume by Sunday. “Most of what we earn from day-to-day operations is held in cryptoassets,” Teng said. “That is precisely why we are able to absorb a loss of this size, immediately, with our own money.”   Americans are prohibited from using the exchange. Binance.US is a smaller, separate entity.  The hack comes at a time when the Trump administration and its regulators have been pushing for mainstream adoption of cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology. In September, the Securities and Exchange Commission approved the so-called Innovation Exemption, which allows for public company stocks to trade on blockchains. The Binance hack is likely to raise concerns among public company executives about adopting such technology, experts said. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission, for its part, recently unveiled a proposal to regulate digital asset transactions and markets. If finalized, the measure would regulate leveraged crypto trades offered to retail customers and establish a new category for crypto exchanges offering the leveraged trades to register with the agency. “There need to be delays and checkpoints” in transactions, said Austin Campbell, a crypto expert and former banker who is now an adjunct professor at the NYU Stern School of Business, drawing an analogy to automobile safety. “The car can be faster, cheaper and more gas efficient if we take out all the airbags and seatbelts,” he said.       Blockchain intelligence firms TRM Labs, Chainalysis and Elliptic have all pointed to North Korea as being behind the Binance heist, with Chainalysis labeling the incident as “the largest in the history of crypto, and one of the single-largest financial crimes of all time.” The funds drained in the attack were a mix of the largest cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ether, and the dollar-backed stablecoins USDT and USDC. Bitcoin fell on news of the Binance attack, dropping below $77,000 for the first time in more than a month. The largest currency traded near the lows of the day for much of Friday.   For the crypto faithful who’d been basking in a two-month-long price rebound, the Binance incident has cast a shadow over the recovery. Binance dwarfs its industry rivals. It holds roughly $135.2 billion in assets, compared with $28.6 billion at the second-largest exchange OKX, according to DefiLlama data.   Binance said the incident may involve a compromised software engineer’s laptop, as well as “additional points of breach.” It found no evidence of leaked private keys, it said. “This was a complex attack, and we are doing all we can in coordination with law enforcement to resolve it,” Binance said in a post on X. An emergency insurance and reserve fund from Binance called the Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU) was established in 2018 to serve as a backstop for customers in “extreme situations,” according to the exchange. The SAFU is generally maintained at around $1 billion, but has fluctuated in the past in tandem with market movements, Binance said in 2024. The two biggest stablecoin issuers said they took steps to freeze affected currency. Paolo Ardoino, the chief executive officer of Tether, said in an X post that it froze more than $1.5 billion of the stablecoin USDT “related to a potential Binance exchange hack.” Jeremy Allaire, who runs Circle Internet Group Inc., said $800 million of its USDC token had been frozen amid “reports of a potential exploit involving Binance.”

items.title: 中国製造業ＰＭＩ、10月は49.3　4カ月で3度目の縮小
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [北京 ３１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[北京 ３１日 ロイター] - 中国国家統計局が３１日発表した１０月の製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４９．３に低下し、景気拡大と縮小の分岐点となる５０を下回った。製造業活動が縮小したのは過去４カ月で３度目。輸出向けと国内向けの財需要の弱さが重しとなった。

ロイターがまとめた市場予想の５０．０を下回った。９月は５０．１だった。

製造業活動が弱まったのは、９月に前倒しされていた海外からのクリスマス関連受注が１０月になって落ち着いたため。国慶節の大型連休中に増加した個人消費も、連休明けには勢いを失い、長期の低迷状態に戻ったことが響いた。

中国物流購買連合会のアナリスト張立群氏は「需要不足が景気への下押し圧力を強めている」と指摘。政策当局はこの問題を深刻に受け止め、できるだけ早く対策を強化すべきだと述べた。

新規受注指数と新規輸出受注指数はいずれも縮小圏にとどまった。生産と購買活動も拡大から縮小に転じた。

サービス業と建設業を対象とする非製造業ＰＭＩも４９．７と、９月の５０．２から低下した。

ＰＭＩは、新規受注や生産、雇用などの状況が前月と比べて改善したか、悪化したか、変わらなかったかについて、購買担当者の回答を基に算出する。５０を上回ると活動の拡大、下回ると縮小を示す。

製造業の一部業種は好調だった。鉄道、造船、航空宇宙機器やコンピューター・通信・電子機器の製造業では、生産指数と新規受注指数がいずれも５３．０以上となった。

特に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業は大幅な増益を報告している。ＡＩデータセンターでサーバーとスイッチを接続する高速光モジュールを製造する中際旭創（ジョンジー・イノライト）は、第３・四半期の純利益が約３倍となった。

一方、国内市場の低迷とコスト上昇は、多くの従来型の製造業や不動産関連企業の重しとなっている。オーダーメード家具メーカーの欧派家居（オッペイン・ホーム）は、同期の純利益が８０％減少した。

ただ、中国経済は第３・四半期の成長率が４．５％と、４─６月期の４．３％から持ち直したことから、追加の景気刺激策なしでも年間４．５─５．０％の成長目標を達成する見通しだ。

製造業の一部業種は好調だった。鉄道、造船、航空宇宙機器やコンピューター・通信・電子機器の製造業では、生産指数と新規受注指数がいずれも５３．０以上となった。

特に人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業は大幅な増益を報告している。ＡＩデータセンターでサーバーとスイッチを接続する高速光モジュールを製造する中際旭創（ジョンジー・イノライト）は、第３・四半期の純利益が約３倍となった。

一方、国内市場の低迷とコスト上昇は、多くの従来型の製造業や不動産関連企業の重しとなっている。オーダーメード家具メーカーの欧派家居（オッペイン・ホーム）は、同期の純利益が８０％減少した。

ただ、中国経済は第３・四半期の成長率が４．５％と、４─６月期の４．３％から持ち直したことから、追加の景気刺激策なしでも年間４．５─５．０％の成長目標を達成する見通しだ。

items.title: Global Markets | European shares stumble at end of best month since June on AI worries
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: European stock markets slid as a global selloff in technology rattled investors, with the pan-European STOXX 600 index closing in negative territory. Concerns over soaring AI infrastructure costs loomed large. However, to add a silver lining, euro zone growth exceeded forecasts amid climbing inflation and borrowing costs, while firms such as Universal Music Group and Sanofi flaunted impressive earnings in these challenging times.
items.body: European shares dropped on Friday, hammered by a global tech selloff that shaved billions off the market values of some chip heavyweights, ending a largely strong month on a sour note.The pan-European STOXX 600 index closed 0.36% lower at 646.75 points, despite recording its best month since June.Results from Amazon and Intel in the US rekindled concerns about the high costs of building out AI infrastructure and prompted a pullback from technology names worldwide. The message from investors is becoming clearer: strong AI demand is no longer enough on its own, Daniela Hathorn, senior market analyst at Capital.com, said.The European technology sector index fell 2.75% for its worst day since July 7 and led sectoral declines. AT&S , Soitec and Technoprobe led losses on the STOXX 600, with declines ranging from 9% to 13%.Robust earnings in Europe this quarter have offered some support to stocks, but the drop on Friday shows how quickly bullishness can evaporate if global sentiment shifts. The market is trying to wrestle with the equation. A huge amount of capex is being spent, relative to the timeline of a return on investment. And at the moment, they don't have an answer to that, Michael Hewson, chief analyst at MCH Market Insights, said.Growth Defies HeadwindsSeparately, data showed the euro zone economy grew faster than predicted last quarter, displaying exceptional resilience to headwinds from expensive energy, even as surging borrowing costs and rapid inflation cloud the outlook.Additionally, French consumer prices rose more than expected in October, recording the highest inflation rate since December 2023.Investors are already grappling with political unrest in the euro zone's second-largest economy, at a time when the country faces mounting pressure from elevated government debt, driving French bond yields to multi-year highs.Universal Music Group jumped 7.89%, topping the STOXX 600, after posting a pick-up in subscription streaming revenue in the third quarter. The media sector rose 1.63%.BP rose marginally after posting third-quarter net income ahead of expectations, while German sportswear maker Puma advanced 5.59% after a quarterly sales beat.Sanofi gained 4.71% after the French pharmaceutical firm reported third-quarter results ahead of analyst expectations and lifted its outlook.Among other movers, Bayer gained 5.46% after winning a trial on Thursday over claims by three women that its Roundup weedkiller caused their cancer.

items.title: US probing possible North Korean link to $6.3 bn Binance hack: Trump
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: The US president said Washington was investigating whether North Korean hackers were behind the record cryptocurrency theft, as Binance said about $3 billion of the stolen assets had been frozen ...
items.body: By Skylar Woodhouse President Donald Trump said the US was looking into whether North Korean hackers were behind a $6.3 billion heist targeting Binance that has rattled the cryptocurrency world. “We don’t know. We’re looking at that,” Trump told reporters Friday in the Oval Office when asked if the hack should be attributed to actors from North Korea. Hackers from that country have been known to prey on the digital asset industry and accused by the FBI and cybersecurity experts of involvement in some of the biggest crypto thefts in recent years. Binance, the world’s largest crypto trading platform, suspended withdrawals and pledged to cover all losses after the hack, the biggest heist the digital-asset industry has ever faced. Binance posted on X that about $3 billion of the assets had been frozen on blockchain networks. In another post, co-founder Yi He said withdrawals were expected to resume by Sunday. “They’re saying they’re guaranteeing it or something,” Trump said. “It was a hack. That’s the problem. You know the old-fashioned way when you used to sign a check, take it out. These are different people. Never see the money anymore. So I’ve always felt it was a little bit dangerous.” “They say they have it pretty much under control,” he added, referring to Binance. Binance has had ties to businesses connected to the president and his family. The firm helped develop a stablecoin for a company that Trump and his sons co-founded. Changpeng Zhao, Binance’s co-founder and former CEO, was pardoned by Trump in 2025 after he pleaded guilty to failing to enforce robust anti-money-laundering measures. The hacking incident came amid growing concern about the risks posed by hackers in the artificial intelligence age. It also marked a setback for an industry that is keen to expand its presence in traditional finance and which has benefitted from Trump’s push to ease regulatory burdens. Western governments have accused North Korea of fostering hacking groups and using them to bring in funds to pay for weapons programs. Trump in recent weeks has floated new US outreach to North Korea, suggesting that a potential meeting with its leader, Kim Jong Un, could happen this year. Earlier this month, however, Trump downplayed those expectations, saying he was “not sure that anybody’s asking for a meeting.”

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝八村が復帰戦で12得点、クリッパーズは黒星　ＮＢＡカップ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）は３０日、シーズン中のトーナメント戦であるＮＢＡカップを各地で行い、八村塁が所属する西カンファレンスＢ組のクリッパーズはティンバーウルブズに１０１─１２７で敗れて黒星発進となった。

左太ももの痛みで２８日のレーカーズ戦を欠場していた八村が先発で復帰。２６分２２秒の出場で３点シュート２本を含む１２得点、５リバウンド、２スチールを記録した。クリッパーズはダリアス・ガーランドがチーム最多の２４得点をマーク。チームはターンオーバー数で相手の１１回に対して１７回を記録し、公式戦４連敗となった。

Ａ組では、マーベリックスがロケッツに１１６─１１１で競り勝った。カイリー・アービングが３５得点、クーパー・フラッグが３３得点とチームをけん引した。

東カンファレンスでは、Ｂ組のセブンティシクサーズが昨季王者のニックスに９８─９３で競り勝った。タイリース・マクシーがチーム最多の２７得点に、先発したレブロン・ジェームズも２０得点、９リバウンド、８アシストと存在感を示した。

Ａ組では、マジックがラプターズに１２１─１１４で勝利。ピストンズはネッツを１１０─９４で下した。Ｃ組のセルティックスはブルズに１２５─１１１で快勝した。

items.title: Ecuador presenta su Proforma 2027 con recursos para sectores clave y un petróleo estimado en US$66
items.author: Catalina Arias
items.summary: La propuesta presupuestaria contempla US$4.251 millones para seguridad, US$5.855 millones para salud y US$6.681 millones para educación, además de recursos para infraestructura y protección social.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El Ministerio de Desarrollo Económico y Productivo de Ecuador presentó este viernes 30 de octubre la Proforma Presupuestaria para 2027, que contempla un monto total de US$50.213 millones, ante la Asamblea Nacional. Esta propuesta busca priorizar proyectos energéticos, fortalecer los servicios públicos y generar más oportunidades para las familias a través de inversión en obras, salud, educación, seguridad y protección social, según informa el gobierno del presidente Daniel Noboa. Ver más: Hasta US$3.000: requisitos para aplicar al programa de becas Ecuador Productivo La Proforma 2027 establece prioridades en ámbitos sociales y de inversión, pero también está orientada a “fortalecer la sostenibilidad de las finanzas públicas”. “El déficit global se constituye en el más bajo registrado durante el periodo de esta gestión, pues representa una reducción de US$1.002 millones frente a Proforma 2026″, señala el Ministerio de Desarrollo Económico y Productivo en un comunicado. Según el Gobierno, esta reducción apunta a avanzar en la sostenibilidad fiscal, mientras se atienden algunas de las principales necesidades de las familias ecuatorianas. La programación se elaboró sobre la base de una serie de supuestos macroeconómicos que sirven de referencia para estimar los ingresos y gastos del Estado. Estos son los principales indicadores contemplados por el Gobierno: Ver más: Ecuador eleva a 2,7% su previsión de crecimiento para 2026, pero alerta por El Niño en 2027 Entre lo que establece la propuesta, se incluye la inversión en obras para mejorar la conectividad en importantes corredores y proyectos como Quinto Puente y Viaducto Sur, en Guayas; vía Yambo–Ambato y el paso lateral Guaranda–Ambato, entre otros. Asimismo, se contempla una asignación de US$4.251 millones para las entidades que integran el Sector Seguridad, entre ellas el Ministerio de Defensa Nacional, la Policía Nacional, el Ministerio del Interior y el Servicio Integrado de Seguridad ECU 911, con el objetivo de respaldar las acciones institucionales orientadas a la protección ciudadana y la seguridad del país. Ver más: Encuentro Noboa-Fujimori: Ecuador y Perú estrechan lazos políticos mientras crece el comercio no petrolero Por otra parte, a los gobiernos autónomos descentralizados (GAD) se les asignarán US$4.346 millones en 2027 por el Modelo de Equidad Territorial y otras competencias, un aumento del 17%, con respecto al presupuesto codificado a septiembre de 2026. Con esos recursos también se espera financiar obras en los sistemas de agua potable y alcantarillado, infraestructura vial, sistemas de riego, gestión ambiental y manejo de desechos sólidos. Además, se establece una asignación de US$1.470,9 millones para bonos, pensiones y otros beneficios sociales para “sostener los mecanismos de protección” en hogares con menores ingresos, adultos mayores, personas con discapacidad y ciudadanos afectados por situaciones de emergencia. En materia de salud, la Proforma 2027 se fortalecerán dos sectores. El Sistema Nacional de Salud, que contará con US$5.855 millones, mientras que la educación inicial, básica y bachillerato recibirá USD 6.681 millones.

Chandler Bing got his happy ending in FRIENDS. Matthew Perry never did in real life

The line between the actor and the character begins to blur when you find out that most of Chandler’s traits were not a performance but just a reflection of the man playing him.

Triya Gulati

31 October, 2026 08:00 am IST

1

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

File photo of Matthew Perry | Reuters

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

C ould it be any more heartbreaking? 

For generations of FRIENDS fans, Chandler Bing, played by Matthew Perry , was the man who could make an awkward silence into a punchline, an existential crisis into a sarcastic one-liner and a stumble into physical comedy. 

He was that friend who always had something funny to say.

Show Full Article

But Netflix’s recently released docuseries, The One About Matthew Perry , makes it difficult to watch Chandler the same way again. I couldn’t help but wonder how much of that laughter was borrowed from a life that was hurting. 

The line between the actor and the character begins to blur when you find out that most of Chandler’s traits were not a performance but just a reflection of the man playing him. Now, Chandler remains frozen in time, forever surrounded by the people who love him. But Perry is gone. 

The similarities between the two are uncanny. Both grew up in broken families. Both had abandonment and commitment issues. Both learned early that humour could be a defence mechanism, a way to deflect attention from feelings they did not know how to articulate. Chandler made jokes when he was uncomfortable, when he was vulnerable, when he was afraid of being rejected. Perry, too, used comedy to navigate the world.  

The One About Matthew Perry was a painful watch because Chandler’s evolution had always felt like a promise. Here was a man who could be frightened, insecure and emotionally awkward, yet still find a home in another person and a group of friends. The documentary tells that Perry, who gave so many people comfort, continued to struggle with his own. 

Even Chandler’s changing appearance throughout the ten seasons of FRIENDS , when viewed alongside Perry’s struggles with addiction, gives a clearer picture. The weight gains, weight loss, the puffiness around his face, the changes that viewers noticed and discussed over the years were visible reminders that Perry was struggling internally. 

While the world blames his dependency on substances or alcoholism, the hurt was something deeper. Just like Chandler, it was the childhood trauma that haunted Perry.

Also read: Tiger Shroff could have been India’s Karate Kid. Bollywood missed the chance

Matthew Perry’s greatest wish and biggest fear
Perry’s experience as an ‘unaccompanied minor’ at just five years old became one of the most heartbreaking blueprints of his life. Detailed deeply in his memoir, Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing , this single memory captured the profound sense of abandonment and loneliness that followed him long before he ever stepped onto the set of FRIENDS .

The initial fame and money blurred the wound, but when it resurfaced, nothing could heal it. 

Rome Shidanlu, Perry’s former girlfriend, whom he met while in recovery, described his romantic life as “intimacy was his greatest wish and biggest fear.” It could just as easily have been a line written for Chandler.

Yet Chandler got something Perry could never—the happy ending. 

Chandler found Monica. He built a family. He learned, slowly and awkwardly, to grow out of his childhood trauma. His story offered the comforting possibility that a man could outgrow his defences, confront his fears and find a home where he no longer had to hide behind a joke.

Perry, who died in October 2023 at 54, did not get to live out the decades of ordinary happiness that Chandler found. 

Hence, Perry was an unconventional hero. He was not perfect. He was a man who struggled, relapsed, tried again and spoke openly about the darkness that followed him. By pulling back the curtain on his own pain, he helped others recognise theirs. His honesty gave people the language, and sometimes the courage, to seek help and keep going.

So, yes, watching Chandler will now feel a little different. 

I will still laugh at his jokes. But somewhere under the laughter, I will always wish the man who gave us Chandler Bing could have found a little more of that happiness for himself.

(Edited by Saptak Datta)

items.title: サッカー＝プリシッチ、ミランと新契約を締結　31年まで
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイタリア・セリエＡ、ＡＣミランは３０日、米国代表ＭＦクリスティアン・プリシッチ（２８）と２０３１年までの新契約を締結したと発表した。

２３年にミラン入りしたプリシッチは、同クラブで通算１４１試合に出場し、４４ゴール２８アシストを記録。２７年６月までとなっていた契約を延長し、３０年ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）以降もミランでプレーすることになった。

プリシッチはクラブ公式の交流サイトを通じて、「ミランは私に全てを与えてくれた。ここは自分の家のようだ。このクラブを心から愛している」と述べた。

これまでチェルシー（イングランド）やドルトムント（ドイツ）でプレーした経験を持つプリシッチは、米国代表として９０試合に出場して３３得点を記録。２２年Ｗ杯と２６年Ｗ杯にも出場し、米国サッカー連盟が選出する年間最優秀男子選手賞を過去４回受賞している。

items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの秋季シリーズ、メキシコ・オープンは３０日、メキシコのビダンタ・バジャルタ（パー７１）で第２ラウンドを行い、平田憲聖が２位を維持した。

平田は３バーディー、ノーボギーの６８とスコアを伸ばし、通算１１アンダーの１３１で首位と３打差につけている。

前日３５位の中島啓太は６バーディー、１ボギーの６６をマークし、通算８アンダーの１３４で２０位に浮上した。金谷拓実は予選落ちした。

アンドルー・ノバク（米国）が６１と猛チャージを見せ、通算１４アンダーの１２８で単独首位に浮上。平田ら５人が２位で並んだ。

items.title: France's credit outlook splits rating agencies: Fitch turns negative, Moody’s stays stable, bond risk sees biggest drop
items.author: Bobins Vayalil Abraham
items.summary: Fitch warned that France’s debt outlook is worsening, projecting debt to reach 124% of GDP by 2028 amid weak growth. Moody’s kept its Aa3 rating unchanged. Despite a recent rally that narrowed the French-German bond spread, fiscal concerns and budget challenges persist.
items.body:
Credit ratings agency Fitch on Friday revised France's outlook to "negative" from "stable", warning that deteriorating fiscal conditions and political fragmentation are undermining debt stabilization prospects.The agency pointed to weaker growth, higher borrowing costs and a wider deficit since its August review, compounded by a fractured political landscape that is making sustained fiscal consolidation harder to deliver.Why Fitch downgraded France's outlookFitch predicted that the debt level for the European Union's second biggest economy would rise from nearly 115.7 percent of GDP in 2025 to 124 percent in 2028. In its last review in August, Fitch had forecast that France's debt would reach 122.7 percent of GDP in 2028. "Weaker growth, renewed fiscal deterioration and higher yields have increased the challenge of delivering the necessary sustained fiscal consolidation to arrest France's worsening debt trajectory," Fitch said.According to Fitch’s outlook, the prospects for debt reduction after the presidential election in April-May next year were "uncertain".It said the political divisions, with far-right and far-left candidates leading opinion poll surveys, would make it difficult to agree "a credible fiscal strategy"."The emerging policy debate ahead of the presidential election has not materially strengthened Fitch's confidence in the prospects for durable deficit reduction that could lead to debt stabilization. Large protests over public services and living costs further complicate the social context for fiscal consolidation," it said. International investors have expressed widespread concern over France's debt level and this has pushed up the interest yields it pays to service debt, which is one of the highest in Europe.
The outlook revision adds to pressure on the government ahead of more planned protests this weekend, underscoring the political challenges of implementing spending cuts and deficit-reduction measures.
French bond risk falls
French 10-year yields hit their highest since 2002 last week at more than 5.14%, rising more sharply than those of most peers, reflecting greater sensitivity to shifts in market confidence amid concerns over France's fiscal trajectory, struggle to pass a budget and social unrest.
Earlier, the INSEE national statistics agency reported Friday that the economy has not grown so far this year and contracted in the period from July to September.
Meanwhile, France on Friday managed to avoid another rating downgrade, this time by Moody’s. Moody’s kept France’s rating steady at Aa3 with a negative outlook. The following markets rally has led to French bond risk being poised for its biggest drop since the 2020 pandemic. According to Bloomberg, the extra yield investors demand to hold 10-year French bonds, known as OATs, over safer German debt fell 13 basis points to 154 basis points on Monday, the largest drop in six years on a closing basis.

SANTA SUSANNA, Spain, Oct 30 : Nonagenarian Japanese bodybuilder Toshisuke Kanazawa took to the stage on Spain's Costa del Maresme on Friday, aiming to prove that age is no barrier to peak physical fitness.
The 90-year-old travelled to the coastal town of Santa Susanna to compete against rivals decades his junior in the masters category for athletes aged 50 and older in a competition held by the International Fitness and Bodybuilding Federation.
Backstage, Kanazawa mirrored the preparations of younger competitors, warming up with his team and applying spray tan before flexing under the stage lights.
"I like to try doing things that nobody else has done, and more than anything I want to pursue bodybuilding for the rest of my life," Kanazawa said.

Kanazawa credits his longevity and conditioning to strict dietary habits, saying that a routine established decades ago has kept him robust.
"This is something I've been researching and want to learn more about. But ever since I turned 50, I've been building muscle by eating a purely Japanese diet: brown rice, natto (a fermented soya bean dish)), and miso soup," he said.
"It's really the classic Japanese way of eating. And thanks to that, I've gone 90 years without ever getting sick."
Though he did not finish on the podium, Kanazawa remains focused on pushing the sport's boundaries, outlining plans for one final appearance before stepping away from competition.
"I'm thinking I might give it one more go at 93. After that, I'll probably have to retire," he said.
"As you get older, you start developing wrinkles, quite a lot of them. In Japan, there's this idea that once you get those wrinkles, it just doesn't look very good anymore."
Ultimately, Kanazawa hopes his perseverance inspires older generations to remain active and challenge conventional limits.
"Once you set your mind to something, you need to develop the mental strength and determination to see it through no matter what," Kanazawa said.
"I want people to work hard just as I have. I believe that if they do, we'll see more people like me even as they get older. That's what I hope for, and I want to be a good role model."

Source: Reuters

items.title: 習主席、訪中のドイツ大統領と会談　友好的な貿易政策要請
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mei Mei Chu　Liz Lee

[北京 ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Mei Mei Chu　Liz Lee

[北京 ３０日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席は３０日、ドイツのシュタインマイヤー大統領と北京で会談し、「理性的で実務的かつ友好的」な対中政策を取るよう求めた。欧州との貿易摩擦が強まる中、平等や互恵、戦略的安定に基づく「全方位的な戦略パートナーシップ」を支持する考えを示した。

習氏は「この新たな関係のあり方は、われわれが閉鎖よりも開放を、対立よりも協力を支持するという前向きなシグナルを世界に送るものだ」とシュタインマイヤー氏に語った。 

シュタインマイヤー氏は欧州連合（ＥＵ）が拡大する対中貿易赤字への対応を強める中、５日間の日程で中国を訪問。前日には、中国の経済的自立に向けた取り組みが他の市場を犠牲にしてはならないと警告していた。独仏は、ＥＵに損害を与える国に迅速に対抗する新措置を提案し、中国を念頭に置いているとみられる。

中国はスイスとの自由貿易協定改定やアイスランドとの航空路線新設など、欧州への外交攻勢を展開している。ただ、ＳＯＡＳ中国研究所のスティーブ・ツァン所長は、自国の経済利益を優先する中国の姿勢に対する懸念を和らげる効果は限定的と指摘。従来、中国との緊密な経済関係を推進してきたドイツ産業界からも、対中政策の厳格化を求める声が強まっていると述べた。

items.title: EE.UU. se suma a la búsqueda de los responsables del hackeo a Binance que sucita un intenso escrutinio
items.author: Myles Miller, Emily Nicolle, Scott Patterson
items.summary: El ataque llevó a Binance a suspender los retiros y comprometerse a cubrir las pérdidas, mientras el bitcoin cayó por debajo de los US$77.000 y las investigaciones apuntan a Corea del Norte.
items.body: Bloomberg — Las fuerzas del orden estadounidenses se han sumado a la búsqueda de los piratas informáticos que sustrajeron más de US$6.000 millones de la plataforma de criptoactivos Binance, en lo que constituye el mayor robo cibernético jamás registrado. La Oficina Federal de Investigación (FBI) tiene conocimiento del incidente y está coordinándose con sus socios “para comprender el alcance de la actividad, evaluar las posibles repercusiones y coordinar las medidas de investigación adecuadas”, según ha declarado la agencia en un comunicado enviado el viernes a Bloomberg News. Los investigadores del Servicio Secreto también están “trabajando sin descanso” junto con el sector privado para recuperar los fondos sustraídos, según ha indicado un portavoz. El Departamento de Justicia tiene conocimiento de las noticias sobre el ataque, pero no hace comentarios sobre las investigaciones, según ha declarado un portavoz. Ver más: Hackeo a Binance 2026: qué es el fondo SAFU y cómo cubrirá las pérdidas de los usuarios a nivel global Aunque aún no se conocen todos los detalles de la brecha de seguridad de Binance, el incidente se produce en medio de una creciente preocupación por los riesgos que plantean los piratas informáticos en la era de la inteligencia artificial. Otros ciberataques recientes han afectado al mercado de predicciones Polymarket, a las entidades financieras surcoreanas Mirae Asset Global Investments Co. y Daishin Securities, así como a la plataforma japonesa de comercio de divisas GMO Internet Group Inc. La mayor plataforma de comercio de criptomonedas del mundo suspendió las retiradas de fondos y se comprometió a cubrir todas las pérdidas. La plataforma puede hacerlo gracias a su inversión continua de ingresos en criptomonedas, según afirmó el codirector ejecutivo de Binance, Richard Teng, en un vídeo publicado el viernes en las redes sociales. Yi He, también co-CEO, afirmó que los ingresos de Binance para este año cubrirían por completo la cantidad perdida. Se esperaba que las retiradas se reanudaran el domingo. “La mayor parte de lo que ganamos con nuestras operaciones diarias se mantiene en criptoactivos”, afirmó Teng. “Esa es precisamente la razón por la que podemos absorber una pérdida de esta magnitud, de forma inmediata, con nuestro propio dinero”. Ver más: Bitcoin cae hasta US$76.300 mientras el hackeo de Binance reaviva dudas sobre la seguridad cripto Los estadounidenses tienen prohibido utilizar esta plataforma de intercambio. Binance.US es una entidad independiente y de menor tamaño. El ataque se produce en un momento en el que la administración Trump y sus organismos reguladores han estado impulsando la adopción generalizada de las criptomonedas y la tecnología blockchain. En septiembre, la Comisión de Valores y Bolsa (SEC) aprobó la denominada Exención de Innovación, que permite que las acciones de empresas que cotizan en bolsa se negocien en blockchains . Según los expertos, es probable que el ataque a Binance suscite inquietudes entre los directivos de las empresas que cotizan en bolsa respecto a la adopción de dicha tecnología. Por su parte, la Comisión de Comercio de Futuros de Materias Primas (CFTC) ha dado a conocer recientemente una propuesta para regular las transacciones y los mercados de activos digitales. De concretarse, la medida regularía las operaciones con criptomonedas apalancadas que se ofrecen a los clientes minoristas y establecería una nueva categoría para que las plataformas de intercambio de criptomonedas que ofrecen dichas operaciones se registren ante la agencia. Ver más: ¿Quién hackeo a Binance? Estos son los indicios del mayor robo de criptomonedas en la historia “Es necesario que haya retrasos y controles” en las transacciones, afirmó Austin Campbell, experto en criptomonedas y antiguo banquero que ahora es profesor adjunto en la Escuela de Negocios Stern de la Universidad de Nueva York, estableciendo una analogía con la seguridad de los automóviles. “El coche puede ser más rápido, más barato y más eficiente en cuanto al consumo de combustible si eliminamos todos los airbags y los cinturones de seguridad”, señaló. Las empresas de inteligencia de blockchain TRM Labs, Chainalysis y Elliptic han señalado a Corea del Norte como responsable del robo a Binance, y Chainalysis ha calificado el incidente como “el mayor de la historia de las criptomonedas y uno de los delitos financieros más graves de todos los tiempos”. Los fondos sustraídos en el ataque eran una combinación de las principales criptomonedas, entre ellas Bitcoin, Ether y las monedas estables respaldadas por el dólar, USDT y USDC. El bitcoin cayó tras conocerse la noticia del ataque a Binance, situándose por debajo de los US$77.000 por primera vez en más de un mes. La mayor criptomoneda se mantuvo cerca de los mínimos del día durante gran parte del viernes. Para los fieles a las criptomonedas, que llevaban dos meses disfrutando de un repunte de los precios, el incidente de Binance ha ensombrecido la recuperación. Binance eclipsa a sus rivales del sector. Cuenta con unos US$135.200 millones en activos, frente a los US$28.600 millones de la segunda mayor plataforma de intercambio, OKX, según datos de DefiLlama. Binance afirmó que el incidente podría estar relacionado con el ordenador portátil de un ingeniero de software que había sido comprometido, así como con “otros puntos de vulnerabilidad”. Según la empresa, no se han encontrado pruebas de que se hayan filtrado claves privadas. “Se trató de un ataque complejo y estamos haciendo todo lo posible, en coordinación con las fuerzas del orden, para resolverlo”, declaró Binance en una publicación en X. Ver más: Binance reanudará los retiros el domingo y apartó US$6.340 millones para cubrir el mayor hackeo cripto En 2018 se creó un fondo de reserva y seguro de emergencia de Binance denominado “Secure Asset Fund for Users” (SAFU), destinado a servir de respaldo para los clientes en “situaciones extremas”, según la plataforma. El SAFU se mantiene generalmente en torno a los US$1.000 millones, aunque en el pasado ha fluctuado en función de los movimientos del mercado, según indicó Binance en 2024. Los dos mayores emisores de stablecoins afirmaron que tomaron medidas para congelar las monedas afectadas. Paolo Ardoino, CEO de Tether, declaró en una publicación en X que se habían congelado más de US$1.500 millones de la moneda estable USDT “en relación con un posible ataque informático a la plataforma de intercambio Binance”. Jeremy Allaire, director de Circle Internet Group Inc. ( CRCL ), afirmó que se habían congelado US$800 millones de su token USDC a raíz de “informes sobre una posible vulnerabilidad que afectaría a Binance”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[３０日 ロイター] - 英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は３０日、米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩが最新の資金調達ラウンドの目標額を１００億ドル引き下げ、企業評価額１兆２５００億ドルで２００億ドルの調達を目指していると報じた。事情に詳しい関係者の話として伝えた。

対話型ＡＩ「チャットＧＰＴ」を手がける同社は当初、企業評価額１兆４０００億ドルで３００億ドルを調達する計画だった。ロイターは先週、競合するアンソロピックが１１月中旬に予定する株式上場を前に、オープンＡＩが投資家の出資取り付けを急いでいると報じていた。

ＦＴによると、オープンＡＩは投資家が出資を確約する期限を３０日に設定した。ただ、一部の投資家が出資額を減らしたため、第１段階の調達額は２００億ドルを下回る見通しだという。

オープンＡＩからコメントは得られていない。

ＡＩへの巨額支出に対する懸念の高まりを受け、３０日の米国株式市場では米ハイテク株が急落。ナスダック総合指数は２．９％安となり、１０月６日に付けた終値ベースの最高値から７．８％下落している。

items.title: Ｆ１＝メキシコＧＰフリー走行、ルクレール最速　岩佐と平川が参加
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［メキシコ市　３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［メキシコ市　３０日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第１９戦、メキシコ・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は３０日、メキシコ市でフリー走行を行い、フェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

フリー走行１回目に最速１分１８秒１２８を記録したルクレールは、２回目でトップタイムの１分１７秒８２７をマークした。

２９日のメディア対応を体調不良のため欠席していたメルセデスのキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア）は１回目で２番手、２回目で４番手だった。個人総合でチームメートのジョージ・ラッセル（英国）に１２３点差をつけて首位に立つアントネッリは、今回のメキシコＧＰで９位以内に入ればＦ１史上最年少王者となる。

マクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）は２回目でルクレールと０秒１０３差の２番手。ラッセルは３番手だった。

残り４７分には、レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）とレーシングブルズのリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）が接触。フェルスタッペンのマシンの破片がコース上に散乱し、赤旗で一時中断となった。

フェラーリのルイス・ハミルトン（英国）は残り３０分でマシンをコース上にストップさせ、バーチャル・セーフティーカーが導入。ハミルトンは無線で「完全にパワーを失った」と報告した。

また、１回目には岩佐歩夢（レッドブル）、平川亮（ハース）の日本人ドライバーが参加し、それぞれ５番手の１分１９秒１１３、１５番手の１分１９秒９８２のタイムを残した。

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝モラントが左太もも裏負傷、最低4週間離脱へ　古巣戦で負傷
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のトレイルブレーザーズは３０日、ガードのジャ・モラント（２７）が左太もも裏の肉離れで最低４週間離脱すると発表した。

モラントは２９日に行われた古巣グリズリーズとの試合で負傷。ＭＲＩ検査の結果、グレード２の肉離れが判明した。４週間後に再検査を受ける予定という。

モラントは第４クオーターで途中退場。この試合では２３分間の出場で１４得点、３アシストを記録した。トレイルブレーザーズは１０３─１２４で敗れ、開幕からの連勝が３で止まった。

今季からトレイルブレーザーズでプレーするモラントは、ここまで４試合に出場し、１試合平均１５．８得点、５．５アシストを記録している。

モラントは２０１９年のドラフト全体２位でグリズリーズに入団。１９─２０年シーズンに新人王、２１─２２年シーズンには最も成長を見せた選手に贈られる賞を受賞し、オールスターにも２回選出された。

一方、けがや銃に関連した問題による出場停止処分などもあった。６月２９日にトレードでトレイルブレーザーズへ移籍した。

items.title: 再送Ｇ２０外相会合、ロシア参加に欧州反発　米長官は協力促す
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
(見出しを修正しました)

Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
(見出しを修正しました)

Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] - ２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合が３０日、米ジョージア州アトランタで開幕した。ルビオ米国務長官は、地政学的な安定と経済的繁栄の拡大に向けた協力を呼びかけ、一連の危機が世界の経済秩序を脅かしていると警告した。 

ただ、ルビオ氏の招待によるロシアのラブロフ外相の参加に多くの外相が反発し、ウクライナと中東の戦争を巡る溝が深まった。会合は共同宣言を採択せず、議長声明を発表して閉幕する見通しだ。

英国のミリバンド外相はラブロフ氏に直接、ロシアの無人機攻撃で前日に１５人が死亡したと指摘し、「あなた方が侵略者であることは、われわれ全員が分かっている」と非難。ラブロフ氏は、ウクライナがロシアの安全保障上の脅威となることは容認できないと述べた。

欧州側がラブロフ氏との写真撮影を拒んだため、恒例の集合写真は見送られた。西側外交官によると、豪州やカナダを含むメンバーの３分の１が撮影に反対した。

また西側当局者らによると、中東の戦争がもたらす経済的課題の深刻さについては、おおむね認識が一致。多くの出席者は、米国によるイラン攻撃が再開すれば、原油価格が急騰して打撃が深まると懸念を示した。

外相らは３１日、供給網（サプライチェーン）や重要鉱物の調達について協議する予定。米中の戦略的競争も合意形成を難しくしている。１２月１４─１６日にマイアミで開く首脳会議での共同宣言採択に向け、調整が続く。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）のカラス外交安全保障上級代表は、ウクライナ支援拡大とロシアの責任追及を求める考えを示した。

WASHINGTON, Oct 30 : A US federal appeals court on Friday reinstated a jury's verdict against the National Football League in an antitrust lawsuit claiming it overcharged subscribers to its Sunday Ticket game telecasts for more than a decade, but said the league can have a new trial on damages.
The ruling by the San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals overturned a lower court judge in California who had thrown out a $4.7 billion verdict against the NFL after the trial in 2024.
The NFL in a statement said it is disappointed by the decision and is weighing its options for further court review of the decision. It defended the televised broadcast strategy as the "most fan-friendly distribution model" in sports and entertainment. 
Lawyers for the plaintiffs — residential subscribers and commercial businesses — did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

"Sunday Ticket" is the only broadcast option for NFL fans who want to watch their teams play out-of-market games.
The subscribers alleged "Sunday Ticket" prices were inflated to limit subscriptions and protect fees for distribution rights that broadcast networks paid to air games in local markets.
A Los Angeles federal jury awarded $4.6 billion in damages to residential subscribers and $96.9 million for commercial subscribers like bars and restaurants. But US District Judge Philip Gutierrez overturned the verdict in 2024, throwing out testimony by two key witnesses and finding that evidence did not support the damages.
The NFL had called the damages amount "nonsensical" and argued that the subscribers never proved with reliable evidence that the league’s Sunday Ticket arrangements actually caused them any harm.
In its ruling on Friday, the appeals court concluded the trial judge was wrong to reject the plaintiffs' expert witnesses. A jury verdict "must stand unless it is clearly not supported by the evidence," the appeals court said.
But the panel said the jury's damages award was based "on its improper consideration of the evidence rather than according to the district court’s instructions."

Oct 30 : Fallon Sherrock beat Luke Littler to claim a £501,000 ($671,089) prize in a live Netflix darts special on Friday, producing a dramatic upset in front of a global audience at Manchester Central.
Sherrock finished from 43 on double top to win a single leg of 501 against Littler, ending the event after 14 previous challengers had failed to beat the two-time world champion.
The 32-year-old from Milton Keynes won the bull-off to earn the throw and produced a 15-dart leg under intense pressure, with the format designed to conclude as soon as a challenger defeated Littler.
Her winning dart sparked celebrations inside the arena as Sherrock, one of the most recognisable players in women's darts, secured the biggest prize of her career.

"Honestly I can't put it into words how I feel, especially with Rory being here," Sherrock said during an on-stage interview with presenter Gary Lineker, referring to her son.
"It's the first time he's been to anything. It was lovely. Sorry, I'm just so lost for words right now. It was a great moment and I'll memorise this forever."
Sherrock, a qualified hairdresser, has become a trailblazing figure in the sport since making history at the 2020 PDC World Darts Championship in December 2019.
Known as the "Queen of the Palace", she became the first woman to win a match at the tournament when she beat Ted Evetts, before following it with another victory over Mensur Suljovic.
"World class," Littler said. "I've enjoyed every bit of it — the ad, the photo shoots, just everything leading up to this. It's been good. Maybe Netflix, we can do it again next year."
($1 = 0.7465 pounds)

items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのメイバンク選手権は３０日、マレーシアのクアラルンプール・クラブ（パー７２）で第２ラウンドを行い、昨年覇者の山下美夢有が単独首位に浮上した。

２位スタートの山下美夢有は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６６をマークし、通算１３アンダーの１３１とした。２位勢に２打差をつけ、２連覇と米ツアー今季３勝目に向けて好位置につけた。

前日２１位で出た吉田優利は７０、同１２位の岩井明愛は７１で回り、ともに通算５アンダーの２３位となった。そのほかの日本勢は、勝みなみが３９位、岩井千怜と渋野日向子が４６位、原英莉花と古江彩佳が５３位だった。

首位で出たポーリーヌ・ルサンブシャール（フランス）は６９で回り、通算１１アンダーの２位。

items.title: Stocks Slump as Wall Street Gets AI Wake-Up Call: Markets Wrap
items.author: Bloomberg

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝マーリンズ、元サイ・ヤング賞アルカンタラの契約オプション行使
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のマーリンズは３０日、サンディ・アルカンタラ投手（３１）との契約に関し、２０２７年年俸２１００万ドル（約３３億円）の球団オプションを行使した。

マーリンズがオプションを行使しない場合、２００万ドルの契約解除金を支払う必要があった。

アルカンタラは今季３６試合（先発３３試合）に登板し、１３勝１１敗３セーブ、防御率３．８７、１５３三振を記録。投球回２１４はメジャー最多だった。

マーリンズのピーター・ベンディックス編成本部長はシーズン終了時の記者会見で、「サンディは球団にとって非常に大きな存在。今季も素晴らしいシーズンだった」と称賛。さらに、チーム内でのリーダーシップや模範的な振る舞いについて「他に並ぶものがない」と高く評価した。

アルカンタラは１７年にカージナルスでメジャーデビューし、通算２１３試合（先発２０２試合）に登板して６５勝７８敗、防御率３．６９。２２年にナ・リーグのサイ・ヤング賞（最優秀投手賞）を受賞したが、右肘のトミー・ジョン手術により２４年シーズンを全休した。

items.title: サッカー＝ルアーブル瀬古と中村先発もＰＳＧに大敗、マインツ佐野は終盤までプレー
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部は３０日、各地でリーグ戦を行い、瀬古歩夢と中村草太が先発したルアーブルはホームのパリ・サンジェルマン戦に１─５で大敗した。

前半１８分に先制したルアーブルだが、同２６分に追いつかれると、その後アクラフ・ハキミにハットトリックを許すなどさらに４失点して大敗した。瀬古はフル出場、中村は後半２０分までプレーした。チームメートの水多海斗はベンチスタートから出番がなかった。

上田綺世が所属するリールはホームにＲＣランスを迎え、後半４１分にオリビエ・ジルーが決勝点を記録し、１─０で勝利。負傷中の上田はメンバー外だった。

ドイツ１部ブンデスリーガでは、マインツの佐野海舟が敵地のエルファースベルク戦で先発し、後半４２分までプレー。チームは１─４で敗れた。

FAST

Oct 30 : Crypto exchanges are taking quick action to bolster their defenses and urging greater industry-wide information-sharing after a record $6.3 billion hack of Binance exposed their vulnerability just as they become more embedded in mainstream finance.
Coinbase said it made adjustments to its systems that store cryptocurrency keys offline "solely out of an abundance of caution," while Kraken said it was monitoring industry incidents for lessons it could apply to its defenses.
But the industry will need to move urgently, analysts and industry executives said, as President Donald Trump's regulators promote deeper integration of digital assets into the financial system, raising the stakes for an industry with a history of big hacks.
"For crypto to reach its full potential, the security situation must be addressed immediately," said Chris Perkins, Franklin Templeton's head of crypto.

Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, halted withdrawals after Thursday's attack — which analysts blamed on North Korea — and said it would use company funds to cover the losses.
Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said on X that the “complex attack” may have begun with a compromised software engineer’s laptop, giving hackers access to systems used to process withdrawals. The company later found additional breaches, while software designed to erase traces of the attack hampered the investigation.
Rival crypto exchanges moved quickly on Friday to shore up their own systems and to reassure customers that their tokens were safe
“Full-time teams at Kraken look for potential vulnerabilities every day,” a Kraken spokesperson said.
Still, even as the industry reeled from the biggest cryptocurrency heist of all time, executives expressed confidence that Binance had sufficient resources to cover the losses and that the hack would not have broader financial repercussions.
Bitcoin fell more than 4 per cent on Thursday while ether, the second-largest cryptocurrency, fell more than 5 per cent, although both tokens recovered some of that ground on Friday.
"Our expectation is the industry writ large will actually not suffer material losses, even though Binance is obviously going to have to deal with the exploit directly," said Josh Riezman, chief legal and strategy officer at crypto firm GSR.
The bulk of the heist unfolded in around 20 minutes late on Thursday and bore similarities to previous attacks blamed on North Korea, according to US blockchain analysis firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis.
North Korea routinely denies involvement in cryptocurrency thefts, and its mission in Geneva did not respond to requests for comment.
HACK INVOLVES SOCIAL ENGINEERING, MONEY LAUNDERING
While much remains unclear, social engineering, a common tactic in which hackers trick victims into revealing sensitive information or granting access to systems, may have been involved in compromising the laptop, security experts said.
Harry Donnelly, CEO of Circuit, a crypto risk infrastructure company, said companies are planning more employee training to guard against social engineering attacks.
In such attacks, hackers race to launder the funds before the exchange detects the breach and token issuers freeze assets. Stablecoin issuer Tether said it had frozen nearly $1.57 billion linked to Binance, while Circle said it froze $800 million. Bitcoin and ether cannot be frozen because no single entity controls the coins.
Chainalysis said the hackers appeared to be using sophisticated laundering patterns it had not seen before.
On Friday, some crypto exchange executives called for the industry to develop a coordinated hack detection system.
"We need a real-time alert system that allows participants to share information immediately when a hack occurs, coordinate a rapid response, and temporarily freeze suspected stolen funds," said Star Xu, CEO of crypto exchange OKX, in a post on X.
GSR's Riezman added that the Binance hack could spur the industry to act: "As we're at this kind of confluence moment for traditional finance and digital assets, I think it's obviously important that we continue to improve, and I think this, if anything, will be a catalyst for that."

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 30 : OpenAI has slashed the target for its latest funding round by $10 billion amid a selloff in tech stocks driven by AI worries, the Financial Times reported on Friday, citing people with knowledge of the matter.
The ChatGPT maker is now seeking about $20 billion and its desired valuation has dropped to $1.25 trillion from $1.4 billion, the report said.
OpenAI set a Friday deadline for investors to commit to the funding round, but the "first close" is expected to raise less than $20 billion after some investors reduced their allocations, it added.
A consortium of UAE investors that includes state-backed technology fund MGX is expected to be the largest participant in the round, and as part of the deal, OpenAI would gain the option to lease newly developed computing capacity in the region, the newspaper added.

Venture capital firms including Founders Fund, Coatue, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz are also expected to participate, according to the report.
Wealthy individuals will have the option to invest in a subsequent retail offering at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the FT added.
OpenAI, MGX, Coatue, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment outside regular business hours. Founders Fund could not be reached for comment.
US tech stocks have suffered a rout amid growing worries over massive spending on AI. The tech-heavy Nasdaq index dropped 2.9 per cent on Friday and is down 7.8 per cent from its all-time closing high reached on October 6.
OpenAI, which is pursuing a listing in 2027, has been keen to close the funding round partly to get ahead of Anthropic's imminent listing as the two are tapping a similar investor base, Reuters has reported.

Source: Reuters

items.title: トランプ氏「北朝鮮の関与調査」、バイナンスの暗号資産流出巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lawrence Delevingne　Summer Zhen　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ボストン／シンガポール／パリ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lawrence Delevingne　Summer Zhen　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ボストン／シンガポール／パリ ３０日 ロイター] - 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスがサイバー攻撃を受けて６３億ドル相当の資産が流出した事件で、トランプ米大統領は３０日、北朝鮮のハッカーが関与したかは分からないとした上で、政権として調査していると述べた。

アナリストは北朝鮮が事件に関与していると分析しており、金融資産の窃盗事件として史上最大となる可能性を指摘した。

トランプ氏は、盗まれた資金を一部でも回収できると思うかと記者団に問われ、「ハッキングだった。それが問題だ。昔は小切手に署名してお金を引き出したものだが、これは違う」と指摘。一方、「ただ、バイナンスは状況をほぼ掌握していると言っている」と述べた。

関係者によると、バイナンスは米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）や米シークレットサービス（ＵＳＳＳ）に協力している。

ＦＢＩは「事件を認識しており、活動の範囲を把握し、潜在的な影響を評価し、適切な捜査手続きを調整するため、関係する官民の協力先と連携している」と表明した。

ＵＳＳＳは、捜査関係者が「民間の協力企業と２４時間態勢で連携し、２９日にバイナンスから盗まれた資金の特定、凍結、追跡、回収に取り組んでいる」と説明した。

ステーブルコイン発行会社テザーは、事件に関連する約１５億７０００万ドルの資産を凍結したと発表。サークルは８億ドル超を凍結した。

バイナンスに主要な営業免許を交付したアブダビ金融サービス規制庁は「バイナンスと緊密に連携し、事件を注視している」と表明した。

写真はフロリダ州デイトナビーチへ向かうため「マリン・ワン」に乗り込む前に報道陣に手を振るトランプ米大統領。REUTERS/Umit Bektas（ロイター） Lawrence Delevingne　Summer Zhen　Elizabeth Howcroft

[ボストン／シンガポール／パリ ３０日 ロイター] - 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスがサイバー攻撃を受けて６３億ドル相当の資産が流出した事件で、トランプ米大統領は３０日、北朝鮮のハッカーが関与したかは分からないとした上で、政権として調査していると述べた。

アナリストは北朝鮮が事件に関与していると分析しており、金融資産の窃盗事件として史上最大となる可能性を指摘した。

トランプ氏は、盗まれた資金を一部でも回収できると思うかと記者団に問われ、「ハッキングだった。それが問題だ。昔は小切手に署名してお金を引き出したものだが、これは違う」と指摘。一方、「ただ、バイナンスは状況をほぼ掌握していると言っている」と述べた。

関係者によると、バイナンスは米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）や米シークレットサービス（ＵＳＳＳ）に協力している。

ＦＢＩは「事件を認識しており、活動の範囲を把握し、潜在的な影響を評価し、適切な捜査手続きを調整するため、関係する官民の協力先と連携している」と表明した。

ＵＳＳＳは、捜査関係者が「民間の協力企業と２４時間態勢で連携し、２９日にバイナンスから盗まれた資金の特定、凍結、追跡、回収に取り組んでいる」と説明した。

ステーブルコイン発行会社テザーは、事件に関連する約１５億７０００万ドルの資産を凍結したと発表。サークルは８億ドル超を凍結した。

バイナンスに主要な営業免許を交付したアブダビ金融サービス規制庁は「バイナンスと緊密に連携し、事件を注視している」と表明した。

items.title: María Fernanda Suárez asume como presidente de Banco de Bogotá tras renuncia de Echeverry
items.author: Daniel Guerrero
items.summary: El exministro de Hacienda y expresidente de Ecopetrol solo duró cinco meses en el cargo. Suárez viene de Banco Popular, el cual dirigió por tres años. La reemplazará temporalmente Luis Fernando Gómez ...
items.body: Bogotá — La Junta Directiva de Banco de Bogotá aceptó la renuncia de Juan Carlos Echeverry a la presidencia de la entidad financiera y designó a María Fernanda Suárez Londoño para asumir el liderazgo del banco. El cambio se produce apenas cinco meses después de la llegada del exministro de Hacienda al cargo. La salida de Echeverry se hizo efectiva el 30 de octubre de 2026. El economista había asumido la presidencia de Banco de Bogotá en mayo de este año, luego de ser elegido por la Junta Directiva en marzo de este año, en reemplazo de César Prado. Suárez, quien hasta ahora se desempeñaba como presidenta de Banco Popular, también perteneciente al Grupo Aval, llega a la dirección de una de las principales entidades financieras del país después de permanecer cerca de tres años al frente de esa organización. Mientras se concreta la transición, Luis Fernando Gómez Falla asumirá temporalmente la presidencia de Banco Popular. María Fernanda Suárez Londoño es administradora de empresas del Colegio de Estudios Superiores de Administración (CESA) y cuenta con una maestría en Gestión de Políticas Públicas de la Universidad de Georgetown, en Estados Unidos. Tiene más de 30 años de experiencia profesional en los sectores público y privado, con una trayectoria que incluye cargos directivos en el sistema financiero, el sector energético, el Gobierno y la consultoría. Antes de llegar a Banco Popular, Suárez fue presidenta de Accenture Colombia, compañía global de servicios de consultoría y tecnología. También ocupó la cartera de Minas y Energía durante el Gobierno de Iván Duque, entre 2018 y 2020. En el sector energético, fue vicepresidenta ejecutiva de Estrategia y Finanzas de Ecopetrol, donde participó en la gestión financiera y en la definición de estrategias de la petrolera estatal. Su trayectoria también incluye responsabilidades en el Ministerio de Hacienda, donde fue directora de Crédito Público. En el sector financiero trabajó en entidades como Citibank, ABN AMRO y Bank of America. También fue vicepresidenta de Inversiones de Porvenir, el fondo de pensiones y cesantías. Adicionalmente, ha participado en juntas directivas de compañías y organizaciones como ISA, Isagen, Cenit, Organización Corona, Corficolombiana y Promigas. Suárez asumió la presidencia de Banco Popular en 2023, después de la salida de Carlos Alberto Upegui. Durante los cerca de tres años que estuvo al frente de la entidad, lideró una etapa de renovación de su imagen corporativa y de definición de una estrategia enfocada en la economía plateada. Ese enfoque buscó fortalecer la propuesta de valor del banco para las personas mayores de 50 años, un segmento al que la entidad orientó parte de su posicionamiento comercial y de sus servicios. Ahora, su llegada a Banco de Bogotá representa un nuevo movimiento en la alta dirección del Grupo Aval y la pone al frente de una entidad con una trayectoria relevante dentro del sistema financiero colombiano.

items.title: Lula enfrenta presión para reformar el Supremo por la polémica entre Moraes y Flávio Bolsonaro
items.author: Martha Beck, Simone Iglesias
items.summary: La decisión del magistrado de ordenar a Flávio Bolsonaro entregar sus pasaportes horas después de la victoria de Lula generó críticas incluso entre aliados del presidente y reavivó el debate sobre una ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva enfrenta un grave problema con el Tribunal Supremo. Se llama Alexandre de Moraes. El influyente juez, que en su día fue elogiado por proteger la democracia de Brasil frente a los intentos de Jair Bolsonaro de socavarla, se ha convertido en un lastre para el presidente reelegido justo cuando este se está preparando para un nuevo mandato con la promesa de sanar las profundas divisiones existentes en el país. Apenas unas horas después de que Lula derrotara a Flávio, el hijo de Bolsonaro, en la segunda vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales de este domingo, Moraes ordenó al candidato derrotado que entregara sus pasaportes, alegando el temor a que pudiera huir del país, dado que se le avecinan múltiples investigaciones penales. Ver más: ¿Por qué investigan a Flávio Bolsonaro en Brasil? Claves de los casos contra el senador que huyó a EE.UU. Después del intento fallido de Bolsonaro de impugnar los resultados electorales, la decisión solo reforzó la percepción entre sus seguidores de que el tribunal está decidido a perseguir a su movimiento político, lo que aumentó la tensión en unas elecciones ya de por sí turbulentas. En entrevistas realizadas a diez personas cercanas a Lula y al Tribunal Supremo, quedó patente un descontento generalizado con la medida de Moraes, que varios calificaron de desastrosa. La decisión irritó al equipo de campaña de Lula e incluso a algunos magistrados del Tribunal Supremo que han estado buscando formas de calmar el enfrentamiento con los partidarios de Bolsonaro, según estas personas. El momento escogido para la decisión de Moraes, pocas horas después de que el tribunal electoral proclamara a Lula ganador, resultó especialmente perjudicial. Según algunas de las personas consultadas, esto proporcionó al candidato derrotado una poderosa justificación para huir del país y proyectarse como víctima de una persecución política. Ver más: El respaldo de Trump a Flávio Bolsonaro abre otro frente de tensión con el Gobierno de Lula Las oficinas de Moraes y Lula no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Hay mucho más en juego debido a un cambio significativo en la composición del próximo Senado, que es el encargado de ratificar los nombramientos del Tribunal Supremo y que también puede someter a juicio político a los magistrados en virtud de un mecanismo constitucional que nunca se ha usado desde el retorno de Brasil a la democracia. El Partido Liberal de Bolsonaro, el principal defensor de la destitución de magistrados, obtuvo 29 de los 81 escaños del Senado. Según una encuesta de Folha de S.Paulo, al menos 49 senadores de todos los partidos que asumirán el cargo o continuarán en funciones el próximo año han expresado su apoyo, con distintos grados de compromiso, a la destitución de magistrados del Tribunal Supremo. Si bien esta cifra no alcanza los 54 votos necesarios para destituir a un magistrado, subraya la presión política que enfrenta Moraes, uno de los principales objetivos del movimiento de Bolsonaro. El Tribunal Supremo de Brasil es una institución poderosa que ha desempeñado un papel preponderante en la política del país durante veinte años, adaptándose a menudo a los vaivenes de la opinión pública. Fue clave para la detención de Lula en 2018 en medio de un escándalo de corrupción masivo, para luego anular sus condenas años después, cuando el clima político cambió. Ver más: Altas tasas y bajo consumo presionan al sector minorista en el cuarto mandato de Lula Durante y tras la presidencia de Bolsonaro, se convirtió en el principal adversario institucional de un líder que atacaba constantemente las instituciones democráticas y difundía afirmaciones falsas sobre el sistema electoral. En los últimos siete años, ningún juez ha ejercido esas competencias con tanta firmeza como Moraes, un héroe para millones de personas que lo aclamaban como una figura clave para la democracia, y un villano para sus detractores, para quienes encarnaba la disposición del tribunal a tergiversar la ley para ampliar su autoridad. Lula, quien en un inicio se benefició de las acciones de Moraes contra Bolsonaro y sus aliados, se siente cada vez más incómodo con la justicia y está bajo una presión creciente para distanciarse de él, de acuerdo con personas familiarizadas con su forma de pensar. Algunos de sus asesores más cercanos piensan que debería haber actuado antes y con mayor contundencia para distanciar a su Gobierno de las polémicas del tribunal, sobre todo después de que salieran a la luz los vínculos entre Moraes y Daniel Vorcaro, fundador del Banco Master, que se encuentra en el centro de la mayor investigación por fraude bancario de Brasil. Aunque otros magistrados también se han visto implicados con Vorcaro, el estilo confrontativo de Moraes y su uso desenfrenado de los vastos poderes del tribunal lo convierten en el principal objetivo de los partidarios de Bolsonaro. Cuando se le cuestionó sobre el tema durante la campaña, Lula expresó su apoyo a las reformas del tribunal que podrían incluir mandatos fijos para los magistrados y criterios más específicos para la elección de nuevos miembros. Ahora, en el palacio presidencial se percibe que dicha reforma ya no puede eludirse. Los aliados han aconsejado a Lula que respalde una propuesta que establecería mandatos de entre nueve y 15 años para los magistrados, fijaría un rango de edad más reducido para los nuevos nombramientos y limitaría la autoridad del tribunal en ciertos asuntos. Ver más: Victoria de Lula da fuerza a los BRICS y puede convertir el peso de Brasil en una ventaja La Constitución de Brasil otorga en la actualidad al presidente la facultad de nombrar a los magistrados del Tribunal Supremo, sujeto a la aprobación de la mayoría absoluta del Senado. Los candidatos deben tener entre 35 y 70 años al momento de su nombramiento, y los magistrados pueden permanecer en el cargo hasta la edad de jubilación obligatoria de 75 años. Si bien algunos políticos han propuesto modificar el proceso de nombramiento para que otras instituciones participen de dicha selección de magistrados, un exdiputado y experto constitucional afirmó que la Constitución asigna explícitamente esa autoridad al presidente y argumentó que redistribuirla entre los demás poderes del Estado sería imprudente. Otra idea que se debate reduciría el abanico de asuntos que pueden llegar al Tribunal Supremo. La Constitución de Brasil de 1988 es excepcionalmente detallada, con 250 artículos que abarcan temas que van desde los derechos sociales y la fiscalidad hasta el derecho penal y la organización del Estado. En comparación, la Constitución de EE.UU. contiene siete artículos y ha sido enmendada 27 veces. Ver más: Lula ganó las elecciones de Brasil y estos son los ajustes que deberá hacer desde 2027 El Tribunal Supremo de Brasil está designado constitucionalmente como guardián de esa extensa carta magna, lo que contribuye a explicar su amplio papel en las disputas políticas y de políticas públicas. Cualquiera de esos cambios requeriría una enmienda constitucional, un proceso políticamente complejo que exige la aprobación en dos rondas por tres quintas partes tanto de la Cámara de Representantes como del Senado. Esos mimos cambios podrían ser impugnados ante el Tribunal Supremo, en especial si se considerara que infringen las garantías constitucionales que rigen la separación de poderes. Esto deja a Lula y al Congreso ante un camino peligroso, pero probablemente inevitable. Cualquier intento de reformar el tribunal corre el riesgo de agravar aún más la crisis institucional entre los tres poderes del Estado. Sin embargo, posponer el cambio podría erosionar todavía más la credibilidad de una institución que ha sido un pilar de la democracia brasileña. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Haas boss Komatsu lashes out at 'nonsense' Bearman salary rumours

Formula One F1 - Mexico City Grand Prix - Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, Mexico City, Mexico - October 29, 2026 Haas' Oliver Bearman ahead of the Mexico City Grand Prix REUTERS/Eloisa Sanchez

FAST

MEXICO CITY, Oct 30 : Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu vehemently dismissed reports that excessive salary demands from Oliver Bearman's camp were holding up the British driver's contract extension, accusing those spreading the claims of inventing stories to generate clicks.
Bearman's future with US-owned Haas has been in the spotlight after the Formula One team confirmed Brazilian Rafael Camara would replace Esteban Ocon for 2027 but stopped short of announcing a new deal for the 21-year-old, whose contract is due to expire at the end of the season.
Some reports have suggested Bearman is seeking an annual salary of six million euros but Komatsu reacted angrily when the figure was put to him.
"I have no idea where that comes from. Honestly. I've experienced this sometimes this season as well. Some people say there's no smoke without fire, but really, some people invent the story," Komatsu told reporters on Friday ahead of Sunday's Mexico City Grand Prix.

"I don't know who smoked up this six million euro number... I have no comment to make because it's just not even close to the truth. It's amazing these days that people don't check the source. Okay, I want to get some more clicks, so they cut and paste those stories and keep running with it."
Both parties want to extend but have declined to say what is holding up an announcement.
"I don't think I can go into the details of what's the hold-up, but it's very clear from both parties, from Ollie's side and our side they want to continue working together," he said.
"We're trying to find a solution to work together next year, and I'm sure we will."
Bearman returns to Mexico with fond memories after finishing fourth at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez last year, matching Haas's best-ever result in Formula One.
Komatsu spoke highly of the Ferrari-backed Briton's progress since his rookie season.
"I just see a huge maturity and growth in his leadership capability, and he's only 21 years old. That is really impressive," Komatsu said.

items.title: テニス＝ズベレフ圧勝、アルカラスも4強入り　エルステバンクＯＰ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスのエルステバンク・オープン（ＯＰ）は３０日、オーストリアのウィーンでシングルス準々決勝を行い、第１シードのアレクサンダー・ズベレフ（ドイツ）と第２シードのカルロス・アルカラス（スペイン）らが４強入りを決めた。

全仏ＯＰと全米ＯＰを制したズベレフは、アーサー・フェリー（英国）に６─０、６─２で圧勝。わずか５８分で試合を終えた。フェリーは前日の２回戦で理学療法士の治療を受けており、この日も序盤から身体に問題を抱えている様子だった。

ズベレフは２９日の勝利で自身初の世界ランキング１位浮上を確定させており、１１月２日付のランキングで史上３０人目のトップに立つ。

アルカラスは第７シードのトミー・ポール（米国）と対戦し、６─４、７─６のストレート勝ち。第２セットはタイブレークを７─２で制して勝利を決めた。

ロシア出身で第３シードのダニル・メドベージェフは、アドリアン・マナリノ（フランス）を６─２、６─３で退けた。メドベージェフはこれで、シーズン最終戦のＡＴＰファイナルに２年ぶり７回目の出場が決定。今季は２０２３年以来となるシーズン５０勝を突破している。

第５シードのアレックス・デミノー（オーストラリア）はマテオ・ベレッティーニ（イタリア）を７─６、６─２で下した。

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝西武が平良のメジャー挑戦容認、パの最優秀防御率
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［３０日　ロイター］ - プロ野球（ＮＰＢ）の西武は３０日、平良海馬投手（２６）がポスティングシステムを利用して米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）への移籍を目指すことを容認したと発表した。

平良は今季、先発に復帰して２３試合に登板し、１２勝５敗、防御率１．３６、１４１三振を記録。パ・リーグの最優秀防御率のタイトルを獲得した。昨季は救援として３１セーブ、防御率１．７１をマーク。通算では３２５試合に登板し、防御率１．７８、６２０三振の成績を残している。

平良は球団を通じ「長い間、メジャーでプレーしたいという思いを持っていたので、ようやくそこに一歩踏み出せたと感じている」とコメント。西武の広池浩司球団本部長は「私の中では、間違いなくＮＰＢナンバーワンの投手」と高く評価した。

ＭＬＢ公式サイトは平良について、時速１５０キロ台半ばから後半の速球に加え、カットボール、スイーパー、チェンジアップ、スプリットなど多彩な変化球を操ると紹介。今オフの移籍市場では、サイ・ヤング賞（最優秀投手賞）２回のタリク・スクバル投手に次ぐ球威と変化球の質を持つと評価している。

一方、ＭＬＢ球団は平良を救援投手として評価する可能性もあり、先発起用への意向が移籍先の選択に影響する可能性がある。

西武が正式にポスティング申請を行えば、ＭＬＢ全３０球団との交渉期間は４５日間となる。契約年数や金額に制限はなく、移籍が成立すれば西武には契約額に応じた譲渡金が支払われる。

今オフは阪神の佐藤輝明内野手もポスティングシステムによるＭＬＢ移籍を目指している。

LE HAVRE, France, Oct 30 : Flying fullback Achraf Hakimi grabbed a hat-trick as Paris St Germain went on the rampage to thrash bottom-placed Le Havre 5-1 and extend their Ligue 1 lead on Friday.
The European champions, who have several regulars out injured, could afford to leave more of their key players on the bench and still come away with an impressive victory as they moved to 20 points from their opening nine league fixtures.
They are two ahead of Lille and four above third-placed Rennes, who have 16 points. Lille moved above Rennes into second after a late goal from veteran Olivier Giroud, who came off the bench to score an 86th minute winner at home for a 1-0 derby victory over RC Lens. 
Rennes were handed a 5-2 drubbing at Nice, who continued their improving form with a fourth win in five outings.
