Elye Wahi netted a hat-trick for Nice, who moved up to seventh after last season narrowly avoiding relegation.
On top of his three goals at Stade Oceane, Hakimi had two assists for the goals scored by Mika Godts and Senny Mayulu after Josh Maja had given the hosts the lead.
It was PSG's ninth consecutive victory in all competitions.
Le Havre suffered a fifth consecutive defeat and sit bottom with two points but they briefly dared to believe as Maja handed them an early lead.
Hakimi set up Godts for the equaliser before putting his side ahead in the 28th minute with a shot in at the near post.
The Morocco international then netted from a free kick into the bottom corner in the 55th minute before being at the centre of a counter attack that saw Mayulu make it 4-1 in the 62nd minute. 
Hakimi completed his hat-trick with a deflected effort in the 69th minute.
"I am happy because some players had very little playing time. If we want to win trophies, we need everyone,” said PSG coach Luis Enrique. 
"With injuries, opportunities arise. That was particularly the case tonight for Quentin Ndjantou and David Boly, who made his Ligue 1 debut.
Wahi’s hat-trick for Nice was made up of two first half penalties and a 73rd minute first time finish.

(Writing by Mark Gleeson in Cape Town)

items.title: 茂木外相、邦人記者の即時解放要求　ラブロフ外相と米で会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[アトランタ（米ジョージア州） ３０日 ロイター] - 茂木敏充外相は３０日、米アトランタで開かれた２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合に合わせてロシアのラブロフ外相と会談し、同国サハリン州でロシア当局に拘束された北海道新聞記者の解放を求めた。

ウクライナ情勢や長年の領土問題を巡って関係が緊張する中、日ロ高官が会談を開くのは異例。

外務省は声明で「茂木大臣から現下の日ロ間の諸問題等に関し、日本政府の立場に基づいて、申入れや主張を行った」とした上で「サハリン州における邦人拘束の件については、茂木大臣から即時解放を強く求めた」と説明した。

ロシアは今月１３日、極東サハリン州で日本人記者をスパイ容疑で拘束したと発表していた。

また声明は、茂木氏が「ウクライナにおける公正かつ永続的な平和の実現のため、ロシアが前向きな対応をとることを改めて強く求めた」とし、両大臣は「日ロ関係が厳しい状況にある中でも、意思疎通をしていくことにした」と述べた。 

インタファクス通信はロシア外務省の発表として、日本側の要請で「ラブロフ外相と茂木外相による短時間の会談」が行われたと報じた。

同省は「ロシア側は、本格的な国家間対話の再開には、日本政府が非友好的な政策を放棄する必要があると強調した」とした。

これに先立ち、アトランタでのＧ２０外相会合では、ウクライナでの戦争を理由に欧州の代表がロシアの参加に異議を唱えたため、恒例の会合前の集合写真撮影が見送られた。

items.title: Trump Can Drive Turnout on Both Sides: Taylor
items.summary: Jessica Taylor, Senate and Governors editor for The Cook Political Report, says President Donald Trump is needed on the campaign trail to drive Republican turnout, but making the midterms about himself could also motivate Democrats and independents to vote against his party. Taylor says Cook moved Florida's Senate race from Solid Republican to Likely Republican because it expects a single-digit contest and says Florida could offer an early indication of how Republicans are performing nationally. Taylor says some states could produce different results in their gubernatorial and Senate races and that the bigger question in the closing days is which voters ultimately turn out. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: 英裁判所、メタなどＳＮＳ3社の異議退ける　情報提供要請巡り
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英国で段階的に導入されている「オンライン安全法」に基づく、英メディア規制当局、情報通信庁（オフコム）からの情報提供要請を巡るメタ・プラットフォームズなど大手交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）３社の異議申し立てについて、ロンドンの高等法院は３０日、退ける判断を下した。

「安全法」では、有害で違法なコンテンツから主に子どもを保護するため、メタが運営するフェイスブックやインスタグラムといったプラットフォーム事業者に厳しい基準を定めている。違反企業に対して世界の年間売上高の最大１０％に相当する制裁金が科される。

オフコムは今年２月、メタや中国系短編動画投稿アプリ「ＴｉｋＴｏｋ（ティックトック）」、「Ｘ」の３社に対し、削除や表示制限された投稿の数、有害コンテンツにさらされた利用者数などコンテンツ管理の詳細の提供を要請。各社は、前例のない規制上の負担をもたらすと主張。Ｘは数百万ポンドの費用がかかると主張していた。

オフコムの報道官は今回の判断を歓迎し、「企業からの情報収集は職務を遂行する上で基礎となるものだ」と指摘した。メタの広報担当は声明で、これほどの規模の情報収集は必要で均衡のとれた範囲を超えているため、異議申し立てを行ったと主張した。

判決は、オフコムにとって追い風となるものの、メタからは手数料や制裁金に関する別の案件も提起されている。

Plus, Jeff Sprecher, Intercontinental Exchange CEO joins to discuss the company's deal with Hyperliquid to bring perpetual futures products into US markets. Then, Bloomberg News Senior Equities Editor Eric Weiner helps dissect today's major selloff. Finally, Brooks Running CEO Dan Sheridan joins ahead of the New York City Marathon to discuss the shoe company's market share and customer demand. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（30日）円3日続伸、株急落　利回り低下
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
＜為替＞　円が３日続伸。日銀が政策金利を据え置き、物価見通しを引き上げたことが材料となったほか、米国債利回りの低下もドルの重しとなった。 

日銀は３０日、金融政策決定会合で金利の据え置きを決定した。ただ、金融政策はよりタカ派的な新たな局面に入ったと強調し、数カ月に１度のペースでの利上げに踏み切る可能性を示唆した。 

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは２．６１％安の７万６７８０．９３ドル。世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことが材料視された。 

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　指標となる１０年債利回りの１０月月間の低下幅が３６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）となり、２３年１２月以来の大きさとなった。週間でも４週連続で低下し、連続低下期間は１年ぶりの長さとなった。

ハイテク関連株の急落で人工知能（ＡＩ）投資への懸念が強まり、安全資産である米国債に資金が流入した。

米１０年債利回りは終盤で６．４ｂｐ低下の４．９２５％。一時は９月半ば以来の低水準を付けた。３０年債利回りは１．９ｂｐ低下の５．３１％で、月間低下幅は同じく２３年１２月以来の大きさとなる見通し。

ＦＲＢの政策金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは８．１ｂｐ低下の４．５７５％。月間では２０２５年８月以来の大幅低下となる見通し。

経済見通しを示す指標として注目される２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は３４．６ｂｐだった。

物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４６１％。２９日終盤は２．４６９％だった。１０年物ＴＩＰＳのＢＥＩは２．３３６％だった。 

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　金価格は１年ぶりの安値を付けた。銀、プラチナ、パラジウムも大幅に下落し、テクニカル指標で売られ過ぎの水準に沈んだ。米東部時間午後２時１３分（日本時間３１日午前３時１３分）時点で、金現物は３．５％安の１オンス＝３８８０．９７ドルとなり、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を記録。銀は６．５％安の４９ドルと、１１カ月ぶりに５０ドルを割り込んだ。パラジウムも１０００ドルを下回った。米金先物１２月物の清算値は３．３％安の１オンス＝３８９８．９０ドルだった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　２％超急騰し、４月末以来の高値で取引を終えた。来週に控える米中間選挙後に、イランとの戦争がさらに激化する可能性に市場が身構える中、ホルムズ海峡でのタンカー攻撃が供給リスクを浮き彫りにした。     清算値は、北海ブレント先物１２月限は２．７６ドル（２．４％）高の１バレル＝１１７．６４ドル。一時、１１８ドルの高値を付けた。１月限は２．６３ドル高の１１３．４３ドル。    米ＷＴＩ先物は２．１２ドル（２．０８％）高の１０４．１２ドル。     月間ではブレントが１３．６％、ＷＴＩが１５．２％それぞれ上昇した。    英国海軍の海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ） によると、３０日にホルムズ海峡で、小型船によって取り付けられた爆発物によってタンカーが攻撃された。攻撃の詳細については、直ちには明らかになっていない。  

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

S&P Global revises Meta's outlook to 'negative' on AI spending, cash flow worries

FAST

Oct 30 : S&P Global Ratings on Friday revised its outlook on Meta Platforms to "negative" from "stable", citing significant uncertainty around the social media giant's capital spending and free operating cash flow.
Big Tech has historically spent heavily on cloud computing, online advertising and e-commerce, but the AI boom has pushed capital expenditure to dizzying levels, stoking investor concerns about whether the sector can generate returns quickly enough.
Last week, Meta forecast annual capital expenditure between $135 billion-$145 billion after reporting a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter. Meta is also planning to tap public markets and sell $97.5 billion in stock to fund the AI buildout.
Meta's ability to monetize its AI investments is more limited than that of its peers, S&P said, adding it was unclear when its revenue streams would generate material contributions exceeding their rising costs over the next few years.

S&P now forecasts Meta will generate FOCF deficits of $39 billion in 2026 and $71 billion in 2027.
The agency said elevated spending could keep FOCF negative beyond 2028 and expects Meta to fund its 2028 cash shortfall entirely with debt.
"Given the lack of clarity around the company's future capex and its very ambitious multi-year AI investment plans, we are less certain that it will curtail its spending as previously anticipated," S&P said.
The ratings agency said it believes Meta's leverage could rise to above 1.0x as early as 2027, which is S&P Global's threshold for the "AA-" issuer credit rating.
"We respectfully disagree with S&P's assertion about Meta's AI monetization capabilities," a Meta spokesperson told Reuters, adding that the company sees "significant product and business opportunities ahead of us, supporting our very strong credit profile."
Meta's leverage increased from 0.1x in 2025, primarily due to its strategy of leasing data-center capacity rather than issuing debt, S&P said.
"If capex remains elevated and continues to grow at a faster pace than we expect, credit profiles will continue to weaken and cash flows will be negative," Naveen Sarma, US media and telecom sector lead at S&P Global Ratings, said.
The company reported long-term debt of $80.92 billion as of September 30.
S&P on Thursday also lowered its outlook on Broadcom to stable from positive, saying the chipmaker's rapid AI growth was increasing its exposure to a few big customers.
Earlier this year, S&P lowered cloud computing giant Oracle's credit rating to "BBB-", one notch above "junk", due to its heavily leveraged balance sheet.

Source: Reuters

CAIRO, Oct 30 (Reuters) – The Saudi-led coalition fighting in Yemen said on Friday it had intercepted and destroyed a drone launched by Yemen’s Houthis over Saudi Arabia’s Medina region, but the Iran-aligned group denied carrying out any attack towards the kingdom.

Medina is home to one of Islam’s holiest sites and is visited by millions of Muslim pilgrims each year.

Cross-border attacks involving the Saudi-led coalition, which backs Yemen’s internationally recognised government, and the Houthis, who control the capital Sanaa, have intensified amid the US-Israeli war on Iran, opening another front in the conflict.

The Houthis have repeatedly denied targeting Mecca and Medina, Islam’s two holiest cities, rejecting previous Saudi-led coalition accusations that it had launched drones towards the cities.

Iran’s IRGC Navy says four tankers catch fire in Strait of Hormuz

DUBAI, Oct 30 (Reuters) – Iran’s Revolutionary Guards Navy said on Friday that four oil tankers had caught fire and exploded in the Strait of Hormuz, while attempting to use what it described as unauthorised routes, Iranian state media reported.

In its latest statement, the IRGC Navy said a fourth vessel, a tanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, had hit a mine, suffered a powerful explosion and was burning.

An IRGC Navy statement had said earlier that one of the tankers, which was also carrying 2 million barrels of crude oil, had hit a naval mine.

Show Full Article

Reuters was unable to immediately verify the statement.

Separately, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency said it had received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz. A verified source told the agency that a crude oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile while completing an outbound transit of the waterway.

Earlier, UKMTO said it had received a report that a vessel was hit by an unknown projectile on its port side about 40 nautical miles (74 km) south of Iran’s Lavan Island, causing a fire on board. The crew were reported safe and there was no reported environmental impact, it said.

Lavan Island lies in the Gulf, off Iran’s southern coast. It was not immediately clear whether the vessels cited by UKMTO were among the four tankers referred to by the IRGC Navy.

Tensions have persisted in the Strait of Hormuz, a strategic waterway through which around one-fifth of global oil supplies pass, since the US-Israeli strikes on Iran at the end of February.

State media said Iranian forces also downed and captured an MQM-170 US drone over Iran’s Qeshm island near the Strait of Hormuz. There was no immediate reaction from the US military and Reuters could not independently verify the report. 

Iran also said it had destroyed an unmanned US vessel in the eastern Strait of Hormuz.

But the US military’s Central Command denied this and said in a statement on X: “All U.S. military unmanned surface vessels in the Middle East are accounted for, including a squadron of advanced sea drones on patrol in the Strait of Hormuz.” 

(Reporting by Yasmine Ghania, Ahmed Tolba and Enas Alashray, additional reporting by Dubai newsroom; Editing by Alex Richardson, Timothy Heritage, Chizu Nomiyama and Sanjeev Miglani)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が３日続伸。日銀が政策金利を据え置き、物価見通しを引き上げたことが材料となったほか、米国債利回りの低下もドルの重しとなった。 

日銀は３０日、金融政策決定会合で金利の据え置きを決定した。ただ、金融政策はよりタカ派的な新たな局面に入ったと強調し、数カ月に１度のペースでの利上げに踏み切る可能性を示唆した。 

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

ＦＸストリートのシニアアナリスト、ジョセフ・トレビサニ氏は「市場は日銀にやや失望している」と指摘。「円は足元でやや強含んでいるが、これまでほど強くはない。日銀の動きを打ち消す米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）寄りのバイアスが依然として残っている」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは２．６１％安の７万６７８０．９３ドル。世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことが材料視された。

円は対ドルで０．１１％高の１ドル＝１５７．５１円。ただ、月間では下落する見通しとなった。

ＦＸストリートのシニアアナリスト、ジョセフ・トレビサニ氏は「市場は日銀にやや失望している」と指摘。「円は足元でやや強含んでいるが、これまでほど強くはない。日銀の動きを打ち消す米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）寄りのバイアスが依然として残っている」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は横ばいの１０１．８８。月間では２カ月続伸となる見通し。 

ユーロは０．１２％安の１．１１６８ドル。月間では２カ月続落となる見通し。

来週はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）とオーストラリア準備銀行（中央銀行）の金融政策決定会合が注目される。 

英ポンドは０．１５％高の１．３３９６ドル。豪ドルは対米ドルで０．０９％高の０．７０３４５米ドル。いずれも月間ベースで上昇する勢いとなっている。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは２．６１％安の７万６７８０．９３ドル。世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことが材料視された。

NEW YORK, Oct 30 : Monday will ring in a brand-new trading month, a prospect that appeals to many after a doozy of a last session in October.
A fresh test of this year’s technology rally sent the Nasdaq composite on Friday to its biggest decline since June. Chipmaker Intel and social media firm Reddit fell 29 per cent and Sandisk, a chipmaker that has been one of the great beneficiaries of the AI capital-spending boom, dropped 13 per cent.
Friday’s selloff came after a bruising for the big tech firms at the center of the AI buildout, led by Microsoft, Meta Platforms, Amazon and Google parent Alphabet. Their shares dropped 1 per cent to 2 per cent on Friday following significant declines earlier in the week. 
The four so-called hyperscalers have been collectively responsible for more than a third of all the capital spending undertaken by the current constituents of the S&P 500 over the past 12 months, Capital Economics said, adding that their share seems likely to rise to an even higher level – a prospect that investors are struggling with.

“Now that the combined capital spending boom at the hyperscalers is becoming partly dependent on external financing, investors are becoming more nervous about the sums they are collectively investing and how they are doing it,” said John Higgins, a markets economist at Capital Economics. 
The Nasdaq 100 index of large nonfinancial stocks fell 3.5 per cent after being down more, putting it on the brink of a correction, referring to a 10 per cent decline from its recent high. The Nasdaq composite is down 7.8 per cent from its closing high, after its worst month since March 2025 wiped out a chunk of this year’s AI-fueled gain.
“Investors are voting all of a sudden and all together on who will monetize the investment and who won’t,” said Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management. 
The damage went well beyond technology shares that until lately have ridden positive sentiment higher, reflecting a broad pullback from risk as Treasuries rallied. Silver dropped 6 per cent, putting it down 31 per cent for the year, and gold fell 3.5 per cent, putting it down 10 per cent for 2026. 
But investors said most of the selling in stocks recently is at first blush a case of 'what goes up, must come down'.
"I don't think it's a particularly troublesome leverage issue that we're dealing with. We've had such a huge move up in the whole complex," said Sahak Manuelian, managing director for global equities sales and trading at Wedbush Securities. 
Oil prices rose 2 per cent, adding to concern about the health of a US economy that many investors see as dependent on the AI buildout for its pep. Financial stocks were hit hard, with Goldman Sachs down 4 per cent and Jefferies off 6 per cent. Bitcoin fell 3 per cent after hackers took more than $6 billion from Binance. 
One question facing investors is whether a new month will mean a fresh start, after a day in which many investors headed for the hills rather than waiting to see what happens over the weekend.
"When you've had the parabolic-like moves, it makes for a very nasty downdraft,” Manuelian said. “And I think that's what we're seeing. And then you have people that are starting to pull money out and going to other areas."

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米、ウクライナに「パトリオット」500発の売却承認　推定21億ドル
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[３０日 ロイター] - 米国務省は３０日、ウクライナにロシアの弾道ミサイル迎撃に不可欠な地対空ミサイルシステム「パトリオット」ＰＡＣ３ミサイル５００発を推定２１億ドルで売却することを承認したと発表した。

同省は声明で、同ミサイルの費用について、ウクライナは米国の「ジャンプスタート」プログラムを通じて調達されるカナダ、ドイツ、ノルウェーからの拠出金に加え、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の「ウクライナ支援融資」で賄われる国家資金で支払う予定だと明らかにした。 

ミサイル引き渡しの遅れは、米国とウクライナ間の緊張を高めていた。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は今週、ロシアがエネルギーや民間インフラへの攻撃を強める中、ウクライナは重要なミサイル供給を米国が承認するのを１カ月近く待っていると述べていた。

items.body:
［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

ニューヨークのウェルススパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント、オリバー・パーシュ氏は「今日だけでなく、今週はＡＩ投資に見合う利益が得られるのか、得られるとすればどれほど早く実現するのかが、大きな焦点だったと言える」と述べた。

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。

items.body:
米国株式市場＝急落、ナスダックは6月以来の下落率　ＡＩ投資に懸念
5:12 配信

2026年10月30日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　３０日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は急落して取引を終えた。ナスダック総合は１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。２９日に発表されたインテルとアマゾン・ドット・コムの四半期決算が期待外れとなり、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連企業による巨額支出を巡る懸念が一段と強まった。

主要３指数はいずれも大幅に下落。ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダックは２．９％安となった 。

アマゾンは取引が進むにつれて下げ幅を縮めたが、インテル株は２８．６％急落した。 

半導体株は大きく値を下げた。エヌビディアが４．２％安、ＡＭＤが１０．９％安となった。フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．２％下落し、月間で１５％を超える下げとなった。

サーバー大手のデルとＨＰはそれぞれ１０．８％安、９．６％安だった。 

ニューヨークのウェルススパイア・アドバイザーズのシニアバイスプレジデント、オリバー・パーシュ氏は「今日だけでなく、今週はＡＩ投資に見合う利益が得られるのか、得られるとすればどれほど早く実現するのかが、大きな焦点だったと言える」と述べた。

主要３指数はいずれも週間で下落して取引を終えた。Ｓ＆Ｐ５００とナスダックは月間でも下落したが、ダウは上昇して１０月を終えた。

第３・四半期の決算発表シーズンは折り返し点を過ぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業のうち２９９社が発表を終えた。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、このうち８２％が市場予想を上回った。アナリストは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成企業の第３・四半期利益が前年同期比３１．６％増加すると予想している。

石油大手エクソンモービルとシェブロンは、ともに四半期利益が市場予想を上回った。エネルギー供給の混乱で利益率が急上昇したことが寄与した。両社株はそれぞれ２．２％高、２．８％高となった。 

コーヒーチェーンのスターバックスは１．８％安。中国事業の売却に伴い、通期売上高が減少するとの見通しを示した。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）関連企業のコインベース、ストラテジー、ロビンフッドは７．２─１０．６％下落した。 世界最大の暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換業者バイナンスで、ハッカーの攻撃により６３億ドル相当の資産が流出したことを受けた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を３．０３対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の出来高は１９８億７０００万株で、直近２０営業日の平均１７２億６０００万株を上回った。

items.title: Isro's GSLV successfully places NVS-03 satellite into 'designated' orbit
items.summary: The GSLV mission placed the second-generation navigation satellite into its designated orbit, restoring NavIC to 4 operational satellites and strengthening India's indigenous navigation ...
items.body:
Home / India News / Isro's GSLV successfully places NVS-03 satellite into 'designated' orbit

Isro's GSLV successfully places NVS-03 satellite into 'designated' orbit The GSLV mission placed the second-generation navigation satellite into its designated orbit, restoring NavIC to 4 operational satellites and strengthening India's indigenous navigation

On NVS-03, the Isro chief said that all the vehicle systems performed as predicted, and as expected (Photo: Reuters)

Press Trust of India Sriharikota (Andhra Pradesh) 4 min read Last Updated : Oct 31 2026 | 8:33 AM IST

Listen to This Article

India's independent regional navigation satellite system NavIC was restored to its minimum operational configuration of four satellites on Friday as Isro successfully launched its navigation satellite NVS-03, which was placed into the designated injection orbit by a GSLV rocket.
The second-generation navigation satellite NVS-03 with indigenous and procured atomic clocks has a wide array of applications including civilian use like real time tracking of trains, vehicles, and shipping vessels.
Further, the NavIC constellation is an important component of the 'one nation, one time' project, Isro chief V Narayanan said after the successful mission launch.
The NVS-03 satellite is all set to complement three other navigational satellites in operation including the NVS-01 and it will strengthen infrastructure for a robust IST with the government recently notifying the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026. The nation's own satellite navigation system 'NaVIC,' is the Indian version of GPS, albeit confined to the country and 1,500 km beyond.
 

On Friday, the 50-metre-tall GSLV rocket carrying NVS-03 lifted off at the scheduled time of 11.51 pm from the second launch pad at Satish Dhawan Space Centre, following a 24-hour countdown.
Also Read

Isro all set to launch latest NavIC constellation satellite on Friday

Prosus Ventures leads $1.5 million funding in space startup Cosmochute

SpaceX, space economy, and India premium

After a flight of about 18 minutes, which saw the successful performance of all three stages including the complex cryogenic upper stage, the primary payload got separated from the launch vehicle and was injected into a Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO).
In his address following the success of the crucial mission, Narayanan said already three satellites, including NVS-01 are successfully working and now, NVS-03 has restored Position, Navigation and Timing (PNT) services.

"NavIC ((Navigation with Indian Constellation) is a strategic national asset which provides independent access to Position, Navigation, Timing services, and it is also used for civilian applications like real time tracking of trains, vehicles, shipping vessels," he said.
Further, he asserted that the NavIC constellation is an important component of the 'one nation, one time' project.
Speaking on the constellation, he said that one of the indigenous atomic clocks had already been placed in the orbit.
He announced that the EOS-05 geo imaging satellite, launched in September, was working perfectly and that the space agency is getting "outstanding" data from it.
On NVS-03, the Isro chief said that all the vehicle systems performed as predicted, and as expected. The GSLV rocket, in its 20th flight, successfully, and precisely injected NVS-03 satellite into the designated orbit.

"The NVS-03 satellite mission has been accomplished with the least turnaround time of 56 days between successive GSLV missions," he said.
He congratulated the entire Isro team, industrial partners, and academia for the outstanding accomplishment, and for the success of the mission. Also, he said that almost 80 per cent of the budget has been "pumped into the Indian industries."   The targeted orbit of NVS-03 has a planned perigee (closest point to Earth) of 170 km and an apogee (farthest point) of 37,023 km.
The 2,232 kg NVS-03 satellite will subsequently use its onboard propulsion to reach its final Geosynchronous slot at 32.5 degrees East. To ensure propulsion system reliability, Isro flew the satellite with its pyrotechnic valves already open, an unprecedented safety measure adopted for this mission.

The satellite, which features an indigenous Rubidium atomic clock, is a crucial addition to the NavIC system and will transmit signals in the L1, L5, and S bands to strengthen India's regional positioning services.
Meanwhile, Union MoS (Independent Charge) Science & Technology, Jitendra Singh congratulated Team Isro for the successful launch of GSLV-F18/NVS-03 mission.
"This remarkable achievement reflects India's growing prowess in Space technology and our unwavering commitment to strengthening sovereign indigenous navigation capabilities. With revolutionary Space reforms announced by PM Shri @narendramodi ji in recent years, India's success stories in Space vindicate the dream of founding fathers Vikram Sarabhai and Satish Dhawan. Today is the celebration of another proud moment for India," he said in a social media post.

(Only the headline and picture of this report may have been reworked by the Business Standard staff; the rest of the content is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[３０日 ロイター] - 米国家経済会議（ＮＥＣ）のハセット委員長は３０日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のリサ・クック理事の住宅ローン不正疑惑を巡り、ホワイトハウスが予定していた聴聞を１２月に延期したと明らかにした。

ただ、クック氏の弁護団は、日程で合意したかどうかについて確認を控えた。

ハセット氏は、ブルームバーグＴＶに対し「ホワイトハウス法律顧問は、クック理事側と非常に緊密に協議してきた。１２月に会ってこれらの問題を話し合う日程で合意したと認識している」と語った。

ホワイトハウスは当初、１１月５日を聴聞の日程に設定していた。クック氏は欧州で金融政策に関する会合に出席する職務があるため出席できないとし、出席できるのは早くても１２月８─９日に予定されるＦＲＢの金融政策会合後になると説明していた。

items.title: Ｇ２０外相、集合写真を見送り　欧州やカナダがロシア同席に反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] - 主要２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）の外相は３０日、米アトランタで開かれた会合を前に、恒例の集合写真の撮影を見送った。欧州の出席者がロシアの同席に反発したことが背景にある。 

米当局者によると、国務省は、集合写真が「見せ物」になったり、会合の妨げになったりすることを望まなかったことから、写真撮影を公式日程から外したという。

西側諸国のある外交官によると、オーストラリアやカナダを含む出席者の３分の１が、ロシアのラブロフ外相との撮影に反対する意向を明確にしたという。 

ドイツのワデフル外相は３０日、会合に先立ち記者団に対し、「欧州のパートナー諸国とラブロフ氏が一緒に写る集合写真は、いかなる場合もあり得ない。ロシアとの関係に正常な状態などないからだ」と述べた。

欧州の当局者は当初、ラブロフ氏を含む写真と含まない写真の２枚を別々に撮影する案を示していたという。

items.summary:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

まちまちで取引を終えた。製薬株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。月間ベースでは１．１７％高と、３カ月ぶりに上昇した。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．８９％安と反落した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は５．１０％高。製薬大手アストラゼネカは７．０％上昇。組織再編計画の発表が買い材料視された。

一方、銀行株指数は３．１９％安。銀行大手ナットウエストは８．８％下落。金利収入の見通しが予想を下回ったことを受けて、売りが膨らんだ。

金や銅が値下がりしたことを受けて、貴金属株指数は５．２８％、鉱業株指数は２．８６％それぞれ下落した。

石油大手のＢＰは０．５％高。２０２６年７─９月期決算で純利益が過去最高となり、買いが優勢だった。ブリティッシュ・アメリカン・タバコは１．７％、日用品のユニリーバは２．１％それぞれ上昇した。

ヒーリー英財務相は今週、初の予算案を発表。課税

ヒーリー英財務相は今週、初の予算案を発表。課税の引き上げ幅が懸念された程ではなかったとして関連株が上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反落して取引を終えた。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は月間ベースでは１．８７％高と、上昇率は今年６月以来の大きさとなった。

米アマゾン・ドット・コムや半導体大手インテルの決算発表を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラ投資を巡る懸念が再燃した。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は前日比２．７３％下落。フランスの半導体材料大手ソイテックは９．６％、イタリアのテクノプローブは９．０％、それぞれ下落した。

一方、メディア株指数は１．６３％高。直近四半期の決算発表を受けて、音楽大手ユニバーサル・ミュージック・グループ（ＵＭＧ）は７．９％値上がりした。

ドイツの製薬・化学大手バイエルは５．５％高。除草剤の発がん性を巡る３人の女性による訴訟で、バイエル側の主張を支持する判断が下されたことが買い材料視された。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス国債利回りが再び急上昇した。この日発表の指標で、同国経済が予想外に縮小した一方、インフレ率の伸びが加速したことが示された。

フランスの第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は前期比０．１％減となり、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想の０．１％増に反して縮小した。一方、消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）は前年比３．８％上昇し、２０２３年終盤以来の水準に加速し、予想の３．６％を上回った。

パンテオン・マクロエコノミクスのユーロ圏担当チーフエコノミスト、クラウス・ビステセン氏は「これらの数字は芳しくなく、公的部門のより迅速かつ広範な財政再建を求める圧力を強めるだろう」と述べた。

フランス１０年債利回りは６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９７％。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは２ｂｐ上昇の４．５０％。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１６５ｂｐに拡大した。

イタリア１０年債利回りは横ばいで推移した。

短期金融市場が織り込む欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）による来月の利上げ確率は約９０％。ＥＣＢは２９日、政策金利を予想通り据え置くと決定した。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。

items.title: フーシ派、アデン空港と大統領官邸にミサイル攻撃＝イエメン政府軍
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[３０日 ロイター] - イエメン政府軍の報道官は３０日、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が同国南部のアデン空港と大統領宮殿施設を弾道ミサイルで攻撃したと明らかにした。

声明では、死傷者や被害の状況、ミサイルが標的に命中したかどうかの詳細は明らかにされなかった。

items.author: CNA

HOUSTON, Oct 30 : Oil prices jumped more than 2 per cent on Friday and settled at their highest levels since the end of April, as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections, with an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz highlighting supply risks.
Brent crude futures for December, which expired on Friday, settled up $2.76, or 2.4 per cent, at $117.64 a barrel, after touching a high of $118. The more active January contract gained $2.63 to $113.43.
US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures settled $2.12, or 2.08 per cent, higher at $104.12.
For the month, Brent finished 13.6 per cent higher, while WTI rose 15.2 per cent.

"Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US and allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial. 
On Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by explosive devices attached by a small boat, said the UKMTO, the British maritime security service. It was not immediately clear who was behind the attack in the strait, the key sea outlet for Gulf crude and fuel supplies. 
It was the first known successful strike in the waterway using limpet mines, explosives that are attached to a ship's hull from a small boat, since the US-Israeli war with Iran began in February, maritime sources said.
'HIGHER LIKELIHOOD OF AN ESCALATION'
The US ordered non-emergency government employees and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia effective October 23 due to safety risks, the US embassy in Riyadh said on Friday, citing Houthi attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure.
Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militants said on Thursday they had attacked several sites in Saudi Arabia, including the large Ras Tanura oil refinery, the Rabigh refinery and a production facility in Abqaiq owned by state oil company Saudi Aramco. 
A Saudi-led coalition also said it had intercepted a cruise missile launched by the Houthis towards the kingdom's western region.
Meanwhile, Qatari mediators returned to Tehran on Friday as part of coordinated efforts to reach a deal between the US and Iran, an official briefed on the talks told Reuters.
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Vice President JD Vance had reached out to Iran to help the country get medical supplies, after US media reported Vance had written to Tehran's top security official to revive peace talks.
Iran has received a letter from Vance, but it has not responded to it yet, Iran's semi-official Tasnim news agency reported, adding that Tehran wants the US to meet its conditions and "any position that contradicts this framework is unacceptable."
Oil prices could become even more volatile in the next couple of weeks due to Israel's recent elections and the US midterm elections on November 3, according to a Saxo Bank briefing on Thursday.
The Danish bank said crude is expected to trade in a higher range of $70 to $90 a barrel even after the conflict ends, compared with a pre-war range of $60 to $70.
SAUDI EXPORTS RISE
Saudi Arabia's crude exports rose in October from September, two of three ship-tracking companies said, despite Iranian attacks on shipping in the Gulf and claims by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis of attacks on Saudi oil facilities.
The US oil rig count, an indicator of future output, rose by two. US crude oil output increased in August, while demand for crude oil and petroleum products declined, the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in its Petroleum Supply Monthly report on Friday.
Meanwhile, Libya's National Oil Corporation said an armed group shut a valve on Friday on the main Hamada crude oil pipeline, which links the Hamada field to the Zawiya refinery. It said the closure of the valve had halted the flow of about 15,000 barrels per day.

Source: Reuters

items.title: ロシア独立紙「ノーバヤ・ガゼータ」廃刊へ、当局の圧力で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrew Osborn　Nika Khutsieva

[モスクワ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrew Osborn　Nika Khutsieva

[モスクワ ３０日 ロイター] - ロシアの独立系新聞「ノーバヤ・ガゼータ」は３０日、１１月９日に全ての活動を終了すると発表した。当局による一連の圧力により編集幹部が起訴され、資金面の支援や事務所も失ったとしている。

同紙は声明で「われわれは殺された。１１月９日に、３０年間過ごしてきたわが家の明かりを消し、サーバーを停止して立ち去る。新聞はもはや存在しない。ロシア当局と治安機関が、われわれ編集部を活動終了に追い込んだ」と発表した。

同紙は２０２２年にロシア国内で紙媒体の発行を停止したが、モスクワ中心部の事務所を拠点にオンラインでの情報発信を続けていた。

共同創設者で元編集長のドミトリー・ムラトフ氏は「われわれは、戦争と流血に反対する社会の非常に大きな層の利益を代表している。だからこそ、彼らは今、われわれにこうしたことをしている」と語った。

その上で、「戦争で人々が命を落とし、政治犯が亡くなっている時に、われわれは自分たちのために泣いたりしない。ただ荷物をまとめるだけだ」と述べ、最後の号を制作中だと明らかにした。

ムラトフ氏は２１年のノーベル平和賞を共同受賞した。

ノーバヤ・ガゼータは、旧ソ連最後の指導者ゴルバチョフ氏のノーベル平和賞の賞金を元手に、ゴルバチョフ氏が掲げた「グラスノスチ（情報公開）」の理念に沿って１９９３年に創刊された。

ロシア当局は同紙を、スパイを意味する「外国の代理人」に指定していた。ロシア当局から直ちにコメントは得られなかった。

items.author: CNA
items.summary: "Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US and allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial.

Oil prices set for fourth straight monthly gains as tanker attack highlights supply risks

"Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US and allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial.

HOUSTON: Oil prices rose on Friday (Oct 30) to their highest levels since the end of April, putting them on track for a fourth straight month of gain s, as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections, with an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz highlighting supply risks .
Brent crude futures for December LCOc1, which expire on Friday, were up US$2.287, or 2.5 per cent, at US$117.75 a barrel as of 1:07pm EDT, after touching a high of US$118. The more active January contract LCOc2 gained US$3.23 to $114.03.
US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures CLc1 climbed US$2.74, or 2.7 per cent, to US$104.79.
For the month, Brent was on course to finish 13 per cent higher, while WTI was heading for a 15 per cent jump.

"Traders will remain focused on oil flows out of the Middle East and the likely escalation by US a nd allied forces," said Dennis Kissler, senior vice president of trading at BOK Financial.
On Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz - the key sea outlet for Gulf crude and fuel supplies - was hit by explosive devices attached by a small boat, s aid the UKMTO, the British maritime security service . It was not immediately clear who was behind the attack .
It was the first known successful strike using limpet mines, explosives that are attached to a ship's hull f rom a small boat, in the waterway since the US- Israeli war with Iran began in February, maritime sources said.
"Continued kinetic action around the Strait of Hormuz amidst doubts of a viable diplomatic pathway is keeping oil prices elevated in expectation of an escalation of the conflict in coming weeks," said Saul Kavonic, head of energy research at MST Marquee.
Meanwhile, Libya's National Oil Corporation said an armed group shut a valve on Friday on the main Hamada crude oil pipeline, which links the Hamada field to the Zawiya refinery. It said the closure of the valve had halted the flow of about 15,000 barrels per day.

Related:

Iran says four tankers on fire after hitting mines in Strait of Hormuz

Rubio hosts G20 ministers as Iran, Ukraine wars divide members

"HIGHER LIKELIHOOD OF AN ESCALATION" Qatari mediators returned to Tehran on Friday as part of coordinated efforts to reach a deal between the US and Iran, an official briefed on the talks told Reuters.
Still, Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi militants said on Thursday they had attack ed several sites in Saudi Arabia, including the large Ras Tanura oil refinery, the Rabigh refinery and a production facility in Abqaiq owned by state oil company Saudi Aramco.
A Saudi-led coalition also said it had intercepted a cruise missile launched by the Houthis towards the kingdom's western region. Saudi Arabia's crude exports have risen in October compared with September, two of three ship-tracking companies said, despite Iranian attacks on shipping in the Gulf and claims by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis of attacks on Saudi oil facilities.
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Vice President JD Vance had reached out to Iran to help the country get medical supplies, after US media reported Vance had written to Tehran's top security official to revive peace talks.
Iran has received a letter from Vance, but it has not responded to it yet, Iran's semi -official Tasnim news agency reported, adding that Tehran wants the US to meet its conditions and "any position that contradicts this framework is unacceptable."
Oil prices could become even more volatile in the next couple of weeks due to Israel's recent elections and the US midterm e lections on Nov 3 , according to a Saxo Bank briefing in Singapore on Thursday.
The Danish bank said heightened uncertainty mak es it difficult to forecast prices, but added that crude is expected to trade in a higher range of US$70 to US$90 a barrel even after the conflict ends , compared with a pre-war r ange of US$60 to US$70.
The US oil rig count, an indicator of future output, rose by two. US crude oil output increased in August, while demand for crude oil and petroleum products declined, the US Energy Information Administration (EIA) said in its Petroleum Supply Monthly report on Friday.

items.title: ＦＲＢ、追加利上げ少なくとも2回必要＝ダラス連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Ann Saphir

[３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Ann Saphir

[３０日 ロイター] - 米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁は３０日、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）がインフレを抑制するには少なくともあと２回の利上げが必要だとの認識を示した。これは、ウォーシュ議長が５月に就任して以降、米中銀当局者が示した金利指針の中でも最も明確なものの一つだ。

ローガン氏は、ノースカロライナ州デビッドソン大学の学生に向けて準備した講演原稿で「現在の見通しを踏まえると、米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）が少なくともあと２回、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施する必要があることは明確だ」と表明。その上で「その後は、追加の措置が適切かどうかを判断するために、経済・金融情勢を見極める一時停止が理にかなっていると考える」とした。

ローガン氏は今週のＦＯＭＣで、短期金利を現行の３．７５─４．００％のレンジに据え置く決定に賛成票を投じた。決定は１０対２だった。ローガン氏はＦＲＢ政策当局者の中でもタカ派寄りに位置する。

さらにローガン氏は「技術分野の投資見通しや地政学的な動向を巡るニュースを受け、金融市場は不安定な状態が続いている」と指摘。「こうした環境では、政策をより緩やかに調整することで、家計や企業、市場参加者が高い金利に適応しやすくなり、経済活動が必要以上に急激に悪化するリスクを軽減できる」と述べた。

ただしＦＲＢが政策の最終到達点を明確にすることが重要だとも述べた。これは、そうした指針は危機時にのみ示すべきだとするウォーシュ議長の主張とは対照的な見解となる。

長期金利については、最近の上昇はより力強い成長とより高い金利への期待を反映したものだと分析。「市場金利の上昇は、経済活動に対する独立した逆風というよりも、金融政策にはまだやるべきことがあると投資家が考えていることを示すメッセージだ」と語った。今週のＦＯＭＣでの政策据え置きはＦＲＢの最終到達点を変えるものではないとも述べ、「市場参加者がＦＯＭＣの政策方針を理解している限り、各利上げの正確なタイミングは、大半の借り手が支払う長期金利にほとんど影響を与えない」と述べた。

items.title: 米追加利上げ「近く」必要、インフレ高止まり＝セントルイス連銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Michael S. Derby

[３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Michael S. Derby

[３０日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は３０日、高止まりするインフレに対応するため、近く利上げが必要だとの認識を示した。

ムサレム総裁は、「シャドー・オープン・マーケット・コミッティー」での講演原稿で、「追加的な金融引き締めが必要であり、それも早急に必要になると判断している」と述べた。

また、「後になって大規模かつ急激な対応を取るよりも、早期に段階的な調整を行う方が通常は混乱が少ない」とし、「インフレ期待が安定している間に、より早い段階で小幅な措置を講じる方が、労働市場や経済成長に悪影響を及ぼすことなく成功する可能性が高い」と語った。

ムサレム氏は、インフレ率が２％目標に比べて依然高過ぎ、上振れリスクが続いていると指摘。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が行動を起こさなければ、インフレが緩和される可能性は低いとの見方を示した。その上で、金融政策は現時点でインフレを押し下げられる状況にないとし、「金融政策と金融環境は依然として緩和的だと考える。金融環境は最近、引き締まった」と述べた。 

さらにムサレム氏は講演後、現在の重点課題の一つは、高い物価上昇圧力が経済全体に波及しないようにすることだと説明。「私が現在、特に注力しているのは、インフレのさらなる拡大や、インフレの二次的影響を抑えることだ」と述べ、「住宅を除いたサービス部門のインフレ、コア・サービス・インフレに注目しており、これらの分野における物価上昇圧力が悪化しないよう注視している」と述べた。

ムサレム氏は今年、連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）の投票権を持たないが、来年には投票権を得る。

China says stealth attack drone makes first takeoff, landing on amphibious ship

China's GJ-21 stealth drone has completed its first takeoff and landing on the Sichuan, marking what state media called "a breakthrough in China's amphibious assault ship programme".

Chinese national flag flies in front of skyscrapers in the Central Business District as China’s Communist Party leaders open the fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee behind closed doors in Beijing, China, on Oct 26, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Maxim Shemetov)

BEIJING: China 's first carrier-based stealth reconnaissance and strike drone , the GJ-21, recently completed its first takeoff and landing on the Sichuan, the country's first Type 076 amphibious assault ship, state news agency Xinhua reported on Friday (Oct 30).
The trial underscores Beijing's push to integrate drone technology into its military modernisation drive, a decades-long effort in which China has developed advanced warships, fighter jets, missiles and increasingly capable unmanned systems.
Xinhua hailed the test as "a breakthrough in China 's amphibious assault ship programme" and said it signifies the navy's ability to operate fixed-wing stealth drone s from large naval platforms.
GJ-21 first appeared at a military parade Beijing held last year to mark the 80th anniversary of the end of World War Two, where it displayed different types of weapons.

State tabloid the Global Times reported on Friday that GJ-21 has a substantial combat radius despite having a smaller airframe than the stealth y J-35 and J-20 fighters, citing military expert Zhang Xuefeng.
"GJ-21 is also low cost and reusable. Unlike hypersonic missiles, it can be recovered and redeployed multiple times. It can also deploy small, low-cost glide-guided bombs. Under high-tempo operations, it offers greater fire delivery efficiency with better cost control," Zhang was quoted as saying.

Related:

The Sichuan, the lead vessel of China 's Type 076 amphibious assault ship class, was launched in December 2024 and features electromagnetic catapult and arresting technology. It can carry fixed-wing drone s, helicopters and amphibious equipment.
The vessel has a full-load displacement of more than 40,000 metric tons and features a full-length flight deck and twin-island superstructure.
China 's state television CCTV said on Friday that the indigenously developed vessel conducted consecutive sea trials in late October. It did not disclose locations of the trials.
China 's navy said in April that the Sichuan sailed to waters in the South China Sea for scientific testing and training missions. It said at the time the deployment was a routine test and did not aim at any specific target.

Source: Reuters/fs

Oct 30 : Alliant Energy expects to sign contracts for about 1 gigawatt of additional data-center demand within six months, its finance chief said on Friday, as rising AI use and growing electrification push US power demand to record highs.
The new load would add to the 3.4 GW that Alliant has already contracted with Alphabet's Google, Meta Platforms and Blackstone-backed QTS Data Centers.
Earnings growth could exceed the company's 8 per cent target if capital spending rises further to support future load growth and other investment opportunities, Chief Financial Officer Robert Durian said on a post-earnings call.
"We continue to work on what I'll call capital upside for different opportunities, including the additional load growth that we may see from the data center prospects that we have," Durian said.

US electricity consumption hit an all-time high in 2025 and is expected to continue rising this year and the next as data-center capacity expands with rapid AI adoption, alongside growing electrification, according to the US Energy Information Administration.
The additional 1 GW is expected to begin ramping up between 2029 and 2031, with related investments spread across the company's current planning horizon and beyond, Durian said.
Alliant also expects Meta to begin taking transmission service in Wisconsin in the first quarter of 2027, marking an early step in its expanding pipeline of large-load developments.
On Thursday, the Madison, Wisconsin-based utility raised its four-year capital expenditure forecast by 19 per cent to $15.9 billion between 2027 and 2030, with peak demand across its system expected to increase by more than 60 per cent by 2031.
It also narrowed its 2026 earnings outlook to the upper half of its prior range and issued 2027 guidance of $3.63 to $3.73 per share. The midpoint was in line with Wall Street expectations, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Alliant Energy serves roughly 1 million electric and 427,000 natural gas customers across Iowa and Wisconsin.

US SEC's top cop says agency is monitoring AI corporate disclosures

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 30 : The US Securities and Exchange Commission is examining artificial intelligence companies' corporate disclosures as investor worries mount over a potential AI bubble that may have been fueled by circular deals, the agency's enforcement director told Reuters on Friday. 
Big Tech stocks sold off this week as companies disclosed they are burning through cash to fuel their AI expansion at a time when interest rates are rising, raising questions about the sustainability of AI spending.
David Woodcock, who became SEC enforcement director in May, said the agency does not want to stand in the way of tech innovation, but that it is the agency's job to ensure issuers are giving investors the full picture on potential risks. 
"Our principal concern is that people are making accurate disclosures about material information so that investors know what they're getting into," Woodcock said in an interview. "Enforcement is a very necessary piece of making sure people are doing that."

Where such disclosure does not happen, "then enforcement will be present," he said.
Woodcock also said that AI and superintelligence have made scams much easier and cheaper to manufacture at scale, raising risks for more and more people. Brokers and other firms need to have processes in place to protect retail investors and "take thoughtful action," he said.
PRIVATE MARKETS AND PREDICTION MARKETS
Woodcock said the SEC will continue to look at issues in private markets, adding that the enforcement team's asset management unit is very focused on conflicts of interest and valuations.
"When people don't make accurate disclosures, whether it's about valuations or whatever, then there is a role for enforcement," Woodcock said. "I think you'll see more activity in this space."
Reuters previously reported the SEC was probing a type of private equity fund as part of the agency's broader interest in the opaque markets. 
Woodcock said the SEC also has a role in overseeing prediction markets, which allow people to bet on real-world events, including sports, government policy announcements and elections.
The markets, led by Polymarket and Kalshi, have surged in popularity over the past two years and have been pushing into US stocks. Such equity-linked prediction markets would traditionally fall under SEC jurisdiction. 
Woodcock said the agency's enforcement staff are working with policy officials as well as the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, which broadly oversees swap markets, to monitor and regulate the booming new markets.
When asked about the possibility of bringing cases against firms that do not register with the agency, Woodcock said the agency does not want to regulate the new industry through enforcement actions. 
"We want to be involved where it makes sense, but not in a way that crushes innovation," he said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Deutsche Bank's AI Dollar Warning Could Hit Bitcoin, Gold, and Stocks
items.author: BeInCrypto
items.creator: BeInCrypto
items.summary: Foreigners own more than $20 trillion of US shares. Deutsche Bank warned Friday that an AI-led selloff could cut both those stocks and the dollar. That woul
items.body: Foreigners own more than $20 trillion of US shares. Deutsche Bank warned Friday that an AI-led selloff could cut both those stocks and the dollar. That would break a decade-old pattern. The dollar usually rises when stocks fall, making it a safe haven. Bitcoin and gold are priced in dollars, and both rallied in August on a weaker dollar and Fed rate bets. Why Foreign Investors Could Lose Twice George Saravelos, Deutsche Banks global head of FX research, set out the case in a client note, Bloomberg reported. He said foreign buying of US stocks now funds the entire US current account deficit. That is the gap between what the US spends abroad and earns. We estimate that roughly 90% of the $20+ trillion value of US equities owned by foreigners is attributable to price appreciation rather than underlying buying. For years, foreigners skipped currency hedging because falling stocks usually lifted the dollar. Saravelos said that cushion flips when the shock starts in the US. Investors rushing to hedge must then sell dollars. That happened after Liberation Day, President Donald Trumps April 2025 tariff announcement. The Bank for International Settlements (BIS) found that hedging by non-US investors fed the dollars slide. Is the AI Dollar Already Breaking With Stocks? Intel fell nearly 30% on a weak forecast, and Amazon slid with other tech names. The SP 500 was down 1.28% by mid-afternoon UTC, TradingView data showed. However, the US Dollar Index, which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, edged up 0.09%. Gold dropped 2.44%, and Bitcoin traded lower. US Dollar Index (DXY), Bitcoin, Gold and SP500 Performance. Source: TradingView Both rank among 2026s worst major assets, despite golds best month since 1999 in August. Deutsche Banks reported comments did not address either asset. DEUTSCHE BANK WARNS AI SELLOFF COULD WEAKEN US DOLLARDeutsche Bank warns the US dollar may lose its traditional safe-haven status during an AI-driven stock market correction. Saravelos named the signal to watch. That is falling US real yields, or bond returns after inflation, alongside weaker stocks and a weaker dollar. It would show markets cutting AI spending forecasts. Fridays trading did not show that mix, as the dollar held firm. Saravelos did not predict a crash. He said dollar risks are more two-sided than markets have priced in recent weeks. FAST

Oct 30 : OpenAI said on Friday it is tightening limits on the weapons-related information ChatGPT provides to teens, even when a question appears harmless, as part of new safeguards aimed at preventing real-world violence.
The move comes as AI companies face growing scrutiny over the risks chatbots pose to young users and the companies' role in detecting threats of harm.
Here are more details:
• OpenAI will restrict practical information on weapons and security systems that could be misused, with the limits applying to teens even when there is no sign of violent intent

• For all users, ChatGPT will be able to automatically end chats where someone appears to be fixating on violence, and OpenAI may temporarily pause accounts after multiple such chats
• The company also said it strengthened its age prediction system to move users it estimates are under 18 into the teen experience, and it plans to notify parents if their teen's account is paused for repeatedly discussing violence
• For all users, OpenAI is limiting detail on past mass attacks, including the weapons used and how they were obtained
• The company said the new safeguards will begin rolling out in the next few weeks, and it will continue to refine them
• OpenAI said earlier this month that teens spend under 15 minutes a day on average on ChatGPT, in its first report on teen use
• A report by non-profit Common Sense Media earlier this month found that ChatGPT's teen version often alerted parents late or not at all when teen accounts held conversations about suicide, self-harm or eating disorders

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Stephanie Kelly　Shadia Nasralla

[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Stephanie Kelly　Shadia Nasralla

[ロンドン ３０日 ロイター] - 英石油大手のＢＰが３０日に発表した２０２６年７─９月期（２６年第３・四半期）決算は、純利益に相当する実質再調達原価利益が８４億６０００万ドルと、現指標の採用を始めて以降の四半期ベースで過去最高となった。前年同期の２２億ドル、アナリスト予想の７３億３０００万ドルをいずれも上回った。中東情勢に伴うエネルギー価格高騰や精製マージンの拡大が寄与した。

２９日に四半期決算を発表した英シェルと仏トタルエナジーズも利益が市場予想を上回り、自社株買い計画の拡大を決定した。

ＢＰは、余剰キャッシュの一部について、１０年に起きたメキシコ湾沖の石油掘削施設「ディープウォーター・ホライズン」の原油流出事故に伴う残存債務に充てる方針を示した。

メグ・オニール最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、自社株買い再開や配当増の可能性に関して、現配当を維持するために債務削減に注力すると説明した。オニール氏は声明で、石油・ガスの生産量は日量約２２０万バレルを維持しているとし、「上流部門のプラントの信頼性と精製設備の稼働率は、前四半期に比べていずれも改善し、トレーディング部門の業績も向上した」と言及した。

営業キャッシュフローは１４８億ドル。一方、純負債は１３９億ドルに減少し、目標を１年前倒しで達成した。指標精製マージンは１バレル＝４６．７ドルと、４─６月期の２９．６ドル、前年同期の１５．８ドルから上昇。主に太陽光発電事業や洋上風力発電の関連で４０億ドルの減損を計上した。

ＢＰは、１２月１５日に長期計画に関する最新情報を発表する予定だ。

items.title: Ｇ２０外相、米国務長官が協調促す　ロシア参加で溝深まる
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrea Shalal

[アトランタ ３０日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は３０日、アトランタで開かれた２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合の冒頭で、一連の危機が世界の経済秩序に深刻な脅威をもたらしていると警告し、地政学的な安定と経済的な繁栄の拡大に向けて協力するよう呼びかけた。世界はエネルギー・食料供給や貿易、航行の自由を脅かすさまざまな危機に直面していると指摘した上で、「われわれには、それぞれの国を代表し、互いに協力して新たな危機への対応を調整し、共通の利益を守る責務がある。地政学的な安定の拡大と、首脳らが取り組む幅広い経済的繁栄の課題に向けた環境を整えることができる」と語った。

今回の会合は２日間の日程で開かれる。

しかし、会合にロシアのラブロフ外相が参加したことに、多くのＧ２０外相が反発。ウクライナと中東の戦争を巡る深い溝が一段と広がっており、専門家や外交官は会合で実質的な進展が妨げられる可能性があると指摘する。

ラブロフ氏の参加を批判してきたカナダのアナンド外相は、冒頭の全体会合を欠席した。同氏の報道官によると、モントリオールでのカナダ・欧州連合（ＥＵ）首脳会議に出席していたため、到着が遅れているという。

南アフリカの外相も欠席した。２０２６年の議長国である米国が招待しなかった。

欧州の一部当局者がラブロフ氏との写真撮影に応じないと表明したことを受け、恒例のＧ２０集合写真の撮影はルビオ氏の公式日程から外された。西側の外交官によると、オーストラリアとカナダを含む参加者の３分の１が反対した。

ドイツのワーデフール外相は記者団に対し、集合写真の撮影自体が取りやめになるとの見通しを示した。「欧州のパートナーとラブロフ氏が一緒に集合写真に収まることは決してない。２９日に述べたように、ロシアと通常通りに付き合うことはできない」と語った。

米国は、重要鉱物に対する中国の支配に対抗する連携を構築する一方、同盟国の関心を貿易不均衡に向けようとしてきた。しかし、多くのＧ２０加盟国にとって最大の懸念は依然として戦争とその経済的な影響だ。

オバマ政権時代に米国務省のチーフエコノミストを務めたハイジ・クレボレディカー氏は、Ｇ２０加盟国のロシア、中国や、ブラジルやインドなどの中堅国が米中の戦略的競争への対応を模索する中、「これまでにないほど分裂が深まっている」と指摘した。過去１０年余り、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は少なくとも「Ｇ２０に臨む前に共通の方針で合意していたが、今はそれすらできていない」と述べた。

items.title: Spanish minister refuses to resign over second major train crash on his watch
items.author: CNA

Spanish minister refuses to resign over second major train crash on his watch

The crash, which killed at least 69 people, marks the second deadly rail accident this year involving the same railway companies.

FAST

MADRID: Spain's transport minister on Friday (Oct 30) rejected calls for his resignation over the second train accident on his watch to cause mass casualties this year, as authorities worked to identify the victims from a crash that killed at least 69 people.
Lawmakers from across the political spectrum this week condemned Transport Minister Oscar Puente for attributing Wednesday's crash to a break in protocol by control centre operators rather than accepting responsibility, with rail workers' unions calling for his immediate dismissal.
The crash, which happened near the town of Urda in central Spain, followed another accident involving the same rail companies on the same line that killed 46 people in January.
It has reopened a debate about safety and maintenance on Spain's high-speed rail network, the most extensive in Europe, as the country prepares for an election that left-leaning Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has called for Nov 29.

"My duty now is not to focus on discussing whether I will remain in office, but on solving the problem, determining exactly what happened and providing clear explanations," Puente said at a press conference on Friday.
At the scene of the crash, large cranes were lifting the mangled wreckage as the Civil Guard listed 64 people as missing in what is already Spain's deadliest train accident since 2013. It was unclear if all those missing were accounted for in the death toll.
Authorities have carried out 49 autopsies so far and formally identified five people, three women and two men, Esther Padilla, spokesperson for the Castilla-La Mancha regional government, said on state television network TVE.

Cranes lift wrecked train carriages as rescuers search for victims following a collision between two trains in Urda, Spain, Thursday, Oct 29, 2026. (Photo: AP/Manu Fernandez)

AUTHORITIES CAN'T RULE OUT MORE FATALITIES No additional bodies were found when rescue teams overturned a train carriage on Thursday, Castilla-La Mancha regional leader Emiliano Garcia-Page said on TVE.
Identifying the bodies was proving difficult because many were in pieces, he said. On Thursday, rescue teams had placed partial remains in 31 bags.
"We cannot rule out the possibility of more fatalities," Garcia-Page said.
The collision occurred after several trains were automatically stopped due to the failure of a signalling system, after which the central control centre in Madrid took over. A train operated by state-owned Renfe was authorised to proceed, even though there was a stationary Iryo-operated train ahead, according to Puente.
Audio of communications between the control centre and the train drivers obtained by El Pais showed how a controller authorised the Renfe train to continue on its journey at a normal speed, which Puente said disregarded a protocol to travel at no more than 40 kph in such circumstances.

CONTROLLERS SAY FOCUS SHOULD BE ON FAILED SIGNAL SYSTEM The debate about who was at fault intensified, with unions saying it was unfair to lay the blame on human error.
Raquel Ayllon, a union leader at state-owned infrastructure operator Adif, said controllers were having to operate under difficult working conditions.
"Human error is being criticised and questioned very quickly, while people are not really focusing on the central issue: the failure of the safety system," Ayllon said on TVE.
Puente said the number of staff working at the control centre in Madrid had almost doubled since 2012 and that the controller who made the call had been working for two hours when the crash occurred.
"I have never used the term 'human error', although that is not to say that there was no human error," he said.
He said the LZB train control system that failed on Wednesday had an average of 170 failures per year, which was about the same as the rest of Europe.
The system was behind schedule for an upgrade, public documents show.

Related:

Spain working 'tirelessly' to identify train crash dead: PM

Grieving Spain demands answers for latest rail disaster that killed 69 people

The European Rail Traffic Management System (ERTMS) has been installed across most of Spanish high-speed rail, according to a factsheet by European rail association UNIFE, which developed the new standard.
Thales España, the Spanish arm of the French equipment maker, won a 2021 contract to install the ERTMS on the Madrid-Seville line, site of the two fatal crashes, by early 2026, but the work fell behind and passed to Hitachi Rail in 2024, according to Thales.
Thales declined to comment on the delay of the rollout.
Puente said the ERTMS system on the Madrid-Seville line was expected to begin working in early 2027, adding that the delay was due to the complexity of installing the system while keeping the line in operation.

Source: Reuters/fs

NEW YORK/LONDON, Oct 30 : A sharp selloff in Wall Street's tech shares pushed MSCI's global index down 1.5 per cent on Friday, sending investors to the safety of US bonds on fears that hefty cash-burning AI investments may not deliver sufficient returns. 
Shares in chipmaker Intel < INTC.O> plunged 28.6 per cent and Amazon shares lost 1.4 per cent after their results each showed that they burned through cash while investing heavily in AI-related development. Intel also said PC demand had slowed, and that it could persist through next year.
Shares in Google parent Alphabet lost another 1.4 per cent, having slid 12.6 per cent on Thursday, after it reported that massive AI spending turned the company's cash flow negative. 
"We've had such a huge move up in the whole complex," said Sahak Manuelian, managing director for global equities sales and trading at Wedbush Securities, referring to AI-related stocks. "When you've had the parabolic-like moves, it makes for a very nasty downdraft. I think that's what we're seeing. And then you have people that are starting to pull money out and going to other areas."

Earlier, Gene Goldman, chief investment officer at Cetera, described Friday's stock trading as a "horror show" with AI spending being the villain as cash burn and elevated capex prompted questions about whether the AI returns will "justify the outlays." 
Goldman also said pressure from rising oil prices due to more attacks in the Middle East and concerns about a hack at Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, added to the gloom. Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies fell.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 572.25 points, or 1.09 per cent, to 51,770.31, the S&P 500 fell 140.32 points, or 1.82 per cent, to 7,580.07 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 747.73 points, or 2.86 per cent, to 25,437.00. 
MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe fell 17.15 points, or 1.51 per cent, to 1,115.47. Earlier, the pan-European STOXX 600 index finished down 0.36 per cent.
On Wall Street, Intel's selloff spread across the chip sector. The PHLX semiconductor index finished down more than 7 per cent after touching its lowest level since May, marking its biggest daily drop since late June. The S&P 500 technology index lost 4.2 per cent in its weakest day since early June.  
Investors looking for safer bets pushed up consumer staples and utilities. But the top performer on the day was energy, which was bolstered by oil's rally and results from Exxon Mobil and Chevron. The oil majors posted strong profits due to big refining margins driven by supply disruptions from Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries and the Iran war.
In currencies, the yen was headed for its third consecutive daily gain against the dollar on Friday after the Bank of Japan held rates steady but revised up its inflation forecast, while a fresh wave of selling in AI shares triggered demand for non-dollar safe havens.  
The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, rose 0.04 per cent to 101.92, with the euro down 0.13 per cent at $1.1163.
Against the Japanese yen, the dollar weakened 0.1 per cent to 157.54.
In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 2.49 per cent to $76,877.30. Ethereum declined 1.01 per cent to $2,236.76.
US Treasuries rose and the benchmark 10-year yield was eyeing its biggest monthly drop in nearly three years as the selloff in technology-related stocks pushed investors into the safe-haven asset.
The yield on benchmark US 10-year notes fell 5.8 basis points to 4.931 per cent while the 30-year bond yield fell 1.97 basis points to 5.3093 per cent. 
The 2-year note yield, which typically moves in step with interest rate expectations for the Federal Reserve, fell 6.64 basis points to 4.59 per cent.
Oil prices settled at six-month highs as traders braced for a potential escalation in the Iran war after the US midterm elections on Tuesday. The war has lingered for eight months without a resolution. On Friday, a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was attacked, highlighting the ongoing supply risks.
US crude settled up 2.08 per cent, or $2.12, to $104.12 a barrel. Brent finished at $117.63 per barrel, up 2.4 per cent, or $2.76 a barrel, on the day.
Precious metals fell. Gold dropped to a one-year low on Friday and silver slid below $50 an ounce for the first time since November 2025, as higher energy prices and persistent inflation concerns strengthened expectations that US interest rates will stay high.
Spot gold fell 3.63 per cent to $3,874.58 an ounce and spot silver fell 6.36 per cent to $49.06 an ounce. 

Source: Reuters

items.title: Gold price slumps to one-year low, silver price breaks $50 as mining stocks tank
items.author: Frik Els
items.creator: Frik Els
items.summary: Bullion is headed for its worst October since 2008, dragging down gold and silver producers as much as 8% on Friday.
items.body:
Gold price slumps to one-year low, silver price breaks $50 as mining stocks tank

Staff Writer | October 30, 2026 | 9:31 am
Iran War   Markets   Canada   Middle East   USA   Gold   Silver  

Edited stock image.

Gold fell to its lowest in a year on Friday and silver dropped below $50 an ounce as rising oil prices hardened bets on another Federal Reserve rate hike and a deepening rout in technology stocks forced investors to sell the metals to cover losses elsewhere, dragging gold and silver producers down as much as 8%.

Spot gold fell as much as 3.2% to $3,891.67 an ounce, its weakest since Oct. 28 last year, and was trading down 2.7% at $3,910.53 by late morning in New York. Comex gold for December delivery dropped 3.1% to $3,907.90 an ounce after touching $3,900.90, a week after sliding below $4,000 for the first time since July .

Click on chart for live prices.

Silver fared worse, sliding 5.8% to $49.34 an ounce, its first time under $50 since November 2025, and is down roughly 18% for the month. The metal has now given back everything it gained since early December, when it began the two-month run that carried it above $120. Comex silver for December delivery fell as much as 6.3% to $49.08 an ounce and was last down 5.9% at $49.31.

Click on chart for live prices.

Volumes were heavy for this point in the session, with futures covering a nominal 18 million ounces of gold and 236 million ounces of silver changing hands on the Comex by midday in New York.

Gold is on track for a drop of about 6% in October, its worst showing for the month since 2008, when the global financial crisis was upending markets, and a second straight monthly decline. Bullion now trades about 28% below the record close of $5,419.83 it set on January 28.

The selling came from two directions. The prospect of renewed US military action against Iran, including an attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, pushed Brent crude to its highest since April and oil toward a fourth straight monthly gain, reinforcing the inflation worries that prompted the Fed in September to raise rates for the first time since July 2023. The Fed and the European Central Bank both held this week but pointed to inflation risks from surging energy costs, and data on Thursday showed US inflation accelerated in September; traders now price a more than 70% chance of a Fed hike in December.

“The indication was that the higher-for-longer theme prevails,” Peter Grant, senior metals strategist at Zaner Metals, told Reuters, adding that inflation worries have multiple central banks continuing to tilt hawkish.

At the same time, technology shares led global stocks lower for a second day as another round of disappointing earnings accelerated a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade and into Treasuries, with the Nasdaq set for steep losses on worries about AI spending.

“Gold is getting caught up in the momentum,” said Bart Melek, global head of commodity strategy at TD Securities, who told Bloomberg that higher oil is triggering a risk-off bid for Treasuries that drains liquidity from equities and bullion alike. Trend followers are now testing long-term support in both metals, he added.

Analysts at Commerzbank said the fall in tech stocks may have prompted margin calls and forced selling, but called the decline in precious metals exaggerated and still expect a recovery.

Physical buyers are not stepping in yet. Demand in India remained subdued this week as buyers held off in anticipation of lower prices, Reuters reported, and demand in top consumer China stayed muted, even as Asian investors have been picking up gold-backed funds that North American investors are dumping.

Silver’s slide has pushed the gold-silver ratio to its highest since December. Ole Hansen, head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, said the divergence underscores silver’s vulnerability relative to gold, and that further liquidation by technically driven funds could open the door to the mid-$40s. Platinum dropped 4% to its lowest since September 2025 and palladium fell 3.1% to a June 2025 low.

Miners: almost $140 billion gone from the top five

Gold and silver producers fell further than the metals themselves on Friday, extending a slide that has left most of the sector a third or more below the highs set earlier this year and that knocked $264 billion off the world’s 50 largest miners in the third quarter.

Newmont, the world’s largest gold miner, dropped 5% by late morning in New York, cutting its market value to $110 billion and leaving the stock more than 20% below its 52-week high. Agnico Eagle Mines lost 6.7% to a $83 billion valuation and Barrick Mining fell 5% to $60 billion, with both now roughly a third off their peaks and Barrick down almost 16% for the year. Wheaton Precious Metals, the largest of the streaming companies, lost 5.1% and trades 30% below its high, while Franco-Nevada, down 2.2%, held up best of the group and sits 21% off its peak.

Kinross Gold was the worst of the majors, sliding 7.7% to the edge of its 52-week low. The Toronto-based company has shed 17% in October alone, has lost half its value from its high and is now worth $23 billion. Alamos Gold, down 5.2% a day after delaying a shaft at its Island Gold mine as costs rise , is also trading at a 52-week low and roughly half its peak, while Harmony Gold fell 7%, Gold Fields 6% and AngloGold Ashanti 5.8%, all three now about 40% below their highs. Eldorado Gold lost 4%, adding to Thursday’s drop on an 18% cut to its gold outlook .

Together, Newmont, Agnico, Barrick, Wheaton and Franco-Nevada, North America’s five most valuable gold companies, have lost almost $140 billion in combined market value from their 52-week highs, with Agnico alone accounting for more than $40 billion of that.

Silver producers have been hit hardest. Hecla Mining fell 6% on Friday and has lost 60% from its 52-week high, taking its market capitalization down to $9 billion. Coeur Mining dropped 6.2% to a $13.5 billion valuation, down 25% in October and 53% from its peak, and First Majestic Silver, down 6%, has lost more than half its value from its high. Pan American Silver fell 6.3%, leaving the Vancouver-based miner worth $16 billion and 44% below its high.

The damage is uneven over a longer horizon. Newmont is still up a third over the past 12 months and Barrick 15%, but Kinross is down 14% from a year ago, and Coeur 28%.

(With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

items.title: 独ＶＷ、主力ＥＶの開発を一時停止　コスト削減が影響
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Christina Amann　Rachel More

[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Christina Amann　Rachel More

[ベルリン ３０日 ロイター] - ロイターが３０日に入手したメモによると、事業再編を進める独自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）は、完全電気自動車（ＥＶ）「Ｇｏｌｆ（ゴルフ）」の開発を一時停止する。コスト削減が、本社にある工場で開発中の将来の主力モデルの一つに及んだ形だ。

ブランドの責任者であるトーマス・シェーファー氏は「決定は容易なものではなかった」とした上で、「現時点で開発に資金を充てる余裕がない」と説明した。

当初の発売目標から既に遅れているものの、ロイターが確認した別のメールによると、開発の一時停止による発売の遅れはないという。

ＶＷは１０万人の人員削減やドイツ内の最大４カ所の工場閉鎖を進めている。２０２６年７─９月期決算で営業損失は過去１０年余りで最も大きかった。

メモによると、ニーダーザクセン州にある本社の工場は、コスト削減目標に対し３億ユーロ（３億３６００万ドル）が不足。工場閉鎖の対象ではないものの、ドイツでの事業に対してコスト削減圧力が強まっている。

産業別労働組合ＩＧメタルとの緊張が高まっており、年明けにスト入りの可能性がある。ＶＷ傘下のアウディによる４０億ドル規模の米国での工場建設計画が、監査役会の承認前にトランプ米大統領参加の集会で発表されたことにも反発が起きていた。

ウクライナのデービッド・アラハミア議員の投稿によると、トランプ米大統領のメラニア夫人が仲介した局地的停戦の下、支援物資を積んだ車列がオレシュキに到着し、一部の住民はウクライナ支配地域を目指してロシア南部アナパに向けて出発したという。同氏によると、住民はその後ベラルーシに空路で移動し、バスでウクライナに戻るという。 

こうした取り組みは、開戦から４年８カ月で初めてとなる。ただ、ロシアのプーチン大統領の報道官は、これを和平に向けた広範な取り組みに「当てはめるのは難しい」との見方を示した。

これに先立ち、ロシア紙イズベスチヤは３０日、オレシュキに向け、食料や医薬品などの支援物資を積んだ車両が夜間に出発したと報じていた。 

ただ、他の地域では依然として攻撃が続いており、当局者によると、ウクライナの７つの地域のほか首都キーウや東部ドニプロがロシアの夜間攻撃の標的となった。２９日にはドニプロの鉄道駅へのドローン（無人機）攻撃で少なくとも１５人が死亡した。

FAST

Oct 30 : Meta Platforms has settled with a teen plaintiff who accused the company of designing Instagram and Facebook to be addictive, causing her mental health problems and disordered eating, attorneys for the plaintiff said on Friday.
The settlement came after jury selection began on Wednesday for a trial that was slated to test the claims of two teens, identified as S.J. and K.D.B., against Meta and Snapchat parent Snap Inc. Meta had settled with S.J. days before the trial, so Friday's settlement with K.D.B. means the trial is expected to proceed against Snap only.
“We remain committed to improving safety for kids on social media apps and holding tech companies accountable, and we are pleased to have brought this matter to a just resolution on behalf of our client,” Emily Jeffcott, an attorney for K.D.B., said in a statement.
A spokesperson for Meta said settlements, dismissals and trials are part of the process of testing cases like this.

"We will continue to defend ourselves in court, and we stand by our record," the spokesperson said, noting that Meta has been building safety tools for more than a decade.
A spokesperson for Snap did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The trial is the second in Los Angeles state court over claims brought by young people who say they became addicted to social media after Meta, Snap, TikTok and Alphabet's YouTube designed their platforms to encourage compulsive use.
S.J. and K.D.B. had previously settled with TikTok and YouTube.
The case was selected among the thousands of pending lawsuits as a test case, so the jury's verdict could influence how the companies and plaintiffs resolve similar cases.
S.J., a 16-year-old girl from Illinois, and K.D.B., an 18-year-old from Mississippi, say they began using YouTube as early as age 3 and the other platforms around age 9, developing compulsive habits they blame on features such as autoplay and infinite scroll. 
The companies have rejected claims their platforms were designed to addict young people, and say they have taken action to make the apps safe places for young people to express themselves. 
Social media companies face thousands of lawsuits in federal and state courts by individuals, school districts, municipalities and other government entities alleging the companies knowingly sought to addict children to their platforms, contributing to a youth mental health crisis involving anxiety, depression and suicide. 
In the first case to go to trial, which ended in March, a Los Angeles jury found Meta and YouTube had been negligent and awarded a young woman $6 million in damages.
The next two teens whose cases were selected for trials either settled or dropped their claims against the companies.
The first school district chosen for trial settled with all of the companies.
In August, Meta struck settlements worth up to $18 billion with nearly every state and US territory to resolve lawsuits brought by attorneys general over the platforms’ harm to teens and agreed to make changes to how Instagram and Facebook work for teens.
Earlier this month, a New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay a $25 billion penalty after a jury found the company misled Facebook users about the privacy of their data and how it handles hate speech. The company has said it will appeal.

Source: Reuters

items.author: CNA
items.summary: Oct 30 : The biggest US technology companies generated record amounts of cash in the first nine months of 2026, yet returned the smallest share of it to shareholders in at least 15 years as surging artificial intelligence spending squeezed share buybacks.The retreat threatens a long-standing source of support

Big Tech returns smallest share of cash to shareholders in 15 years, given AI spending

FAST

Oct 30 : The biggest US technology companies generated record amounts of cash in the first nine months of 2026, yet returned the smallest share of it to shareholders in at least 15 years as surging artificial intelligence spending squeezed share buybacks.
The retreat threatens a long-standing source of support for technology share prices. With companies buying back fewer shares, investors are increasingly dependent on heavy AI investments delivering enough profit growth to justify their valuations.
Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle returned 9.3 per cent of the cash their businesses generated as dividends and buybacks in the first three quarters of the year, down from 27.4 per cent a year earlier, a Reuters analysis of LSEG data and companies' financial reports showed.
Operating cash flow actually rose 29 per cent from a year earlier to a record $542.9 billion.

But capital spending, driven by the AI boom, doubled to $556.9 billion, exceeding the cash the five firms generated for the first time in data going back to 2011.
That left them with a combined free cash flow deficit of $14 billion, against a surplus of $143.5 billion a year earlier.
The squeeze has hit buybacks hardest. The five companies cut repurchases 83 per cent to $13.6 billion, from $81.8 billion a year earlier.
BUYBACKS FIRST TO GO
Dividends, which investors treat as a commitment, rose to $37 billion in the first nine months of 2026 from $33.9 billion a year earlier. Buybacks almost disappeared.
Alphabet and Meta have not repurchased a share in 2026, after buying back $66.5 billion in the first nine months of last year. Amazon pays no dividend and has not bought back shares since 2022.
Microsoft accounted for nearly all the five companies’ remaining repurchases, and cut its buybacks to $4.4 billion in the September quarter from $5.7 billion a year earlier.
Some companies are no longer covering their payouts from what their businesses earn after capital spending.
With combined free cash flow (FCF) negative, the five companies’ $50.6 billion in payouts was effectively funded from cash reserves, borrowing or share sales.
Amazon’s capital spending of $75.9 billion in the third quarter was almost 80 per cent more than the $42.4 billion its operations generated, and it raised $48.1 billion of long-term debt in the quarter.
Alphabet’s free cash flow was also negative, and it raised about $12.4 billion from share sales and $29 billion from debt.
THE HIDDEN COST
The loss of buybacks matters more than the dollar figures suggest, because buybacks have flattered per-share earnings for years.
When companies buy back and retire their own shares, profits are spread across fewer shares, lifting earnings per share even when total profits do not grow.
Alphabet reduced its share count by 9.5 per cent between the end of 2020 and 2025 through buybacks, ING said. That alone provided a boost of roughly 2 per cent a year to earnings per share (EPS), even without any increase in profits.
Without that boost, per-share earnings must come from actual profit growth. That is a harder test, and it arrives just as depreciation charges on new data centres start to rise.
It also lands where investors are most sensitive. Investors care “so much more about EPS than FCF,” Mark Schilsky, a technology sector specialist at JPMorgan, said in a client note last week.
Technology and communication services stocks, which account for about 43.5 per cent of US market value, delivered a shareholder yield of just 0.28 per cent in July, against 1.99 per cent for the rest of the market, MSCI found.
NO END IN SIGHT
Amazon said it still expects about $220 billion of capital spending this year, and the other companies have signalled further increases.
That leaves Big Tech shareholders with a different bargain from the one they signed up for, accepting less cash today in exchange for a bet that AI will eventually generate enough profit to make up for it.
"For the last 15 years, companies increasingly returned excess capital to shareholders through buybacks and dividends," said Ehren Stanhope, co-head of investment management at Franklin Templeton.
"The current regime may increasingly be characterized by greater equity and debt issuance, a request of capital from investors."

(Reporting By Patturaja Murugaboopathy, Editing by Vidya Ranganathan and Nia Williams)

Source: Reuters
